  # La LÍNEA DE PRODUCTO como DATO (C2, I-2): cada estación lleva su realización ejecutable. m02 la
  # materializa en stations/<id>.yml. 100% derivable del spec (ADR-011).
  station_sequence:
    - id: s0
      name: "generar el producto + contrato tipado (tsc --strict) — DES-6/DES-8"
      activation: always
      # s0 corre el slot generate: el scaffolder DETERMINISTA emite el producto TS completo (src/contract.ts,
      # src/handler.ts, src/ui.ts, test/handler.test.ts, package.json, tsconfig.json) en build/product/. dest =
      # un MANIFEST canary (lo escribe al final). El check bootstrapea el toolchain (npm install typescript) y
      # corre tsc --noEmit --strict sobre src/: el contrato tipado compila junto a frontend+backend (drift → rojo).
      proof_checks:
        - { name: typed_contract, cmd: "tsc --noEmit --strict sobre src/ (contract+handler+ui)", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: tsc, status: built }
      builds:
        - action: generate
          dest: build/product/MANIFEST.txt
          brief: |
            Generá la app web full-stack mínima de la fábrica {{slug}} en build/product/ desde el blueprint
            (domain.product): entidad tipada, contrato compartido (DES-6), backend create/list, frontend que
            renderiza la lista, tests node:test. tsc --noEmit --strict debe pasar sobre src/.
          via: ["python", "codegen/scaffold_product.py"]
      checks:
        - name: typed_contract
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: ["npm", "install", "--no-audit", "--no-fund", "--loglevel=error"]
          cmd: ["node_modules/.bin/tsc", "--noEmit"]
    - id: s1
      name: "backend probado en el toolchain DEL producto (node:test) — DES-8"
      activation: always
      depends_on: [s0]
      proof_checks:
        - { name: backend_unit, cmd: "node --test test/handler.test.ts", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: "node-test", status: built }
      builds: []
      checks:
        - name: backend_unit
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["node", "--experimental-strip-types", "--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning", "--test", "test/handler.test.ts"]
    - id: s2
      name: "el PRODUCTO contra la DB relacional VIVA: integración node:test → server node:sqlite (E1, M8 del producto) — DES-4/DES-9"
      activation: always
      depends_on: [s1]
      # MAT-3: el proof deja de ser el glue standalone y pasa a ser el TEST DEL PRODUCTO (workdir=build/product,
      # bootstrap = npm install del toolchain del producto) contra el server node:sqlite que `infra_up` levanta
      # desde ../infra. DB caída → el test del producto cae a rojo (diente de dos lados de E1, M8 del producto).
      proof_checks:
        - { name: db_round_trip, cmd: "node --test test/db_integration.test.ts contra el server node:sqlite vivo", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: "node-test", status: built }
      builds:
        - { action: emit_infra }
      checks:
        - name: db_round_trip
          kind: infra_up
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: ["npm", "install", "--no-audit", "--no-fund", "--loglevel=error"]
          up: ["node", "--experimental-strip-types", "--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning", "../infra/dbserver.ts", "db.sock"]
          proof: ["node", "--experimental-strip-types", "--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning", "--test", "test/db_integration.test.ts"]
          down: []
          timeout: 15
    - id: s3
      name: "lógica de dominio GENERADA por claude -p (LLM vivo) bajo contract test — MAT-2"
      activation: always
      depends_on: [s2]
      # El slot `generate` corre el `via = claude -p` (wrapper codegen/gen_llm.py): genera la IMPLEMENTACIÓN
      # de summarizeTodos. `skip_if_exists: true` ⇒ una vez pineada (committeada) NO se re-genera; ci
      # --rederive verifica el pin sin LLM (§7). El test + package.json se EMITEN deterministas (write); el
      # ÚNICO artefacto no-determinista es summarize.ts. Un stub no pasa el contract test (anti-patrón F1).
      proof_checks:
        - { name: domain_logic_contract, cmd: "node --test sobre la lógica de dominio generada por LLM", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: "node-test", status: built }
      builds:
        - action: write
          dest: domain_gen/package.json
          content: |
            { "type": "module", "private": true }
        - action: write
          dest: domain_gen/summarize.test.ts
          content: |
            import { test } from "node:test";
            import assert from "node:assert/strict";
            import { summarizeTodos, type Todo } from "./summarize.ts";

            test("summarizeTodos: total, done y los titles de los pendientes en orden", () => {
              const todos: Todo[] = [
                { id: 1, title: "comprar pan", done: false },
                { id: 2, title: "lavar", done: true },
                { id: 3, title: "estudiar", done: false },
              ];
              const s = summarizeTodos(todos);
              assert.equal(s.total, 3);
              assert.equal(s.done, 1);
              assert.deepEqual(s.pending, ["comprar pan", "estudiar"]);
            });

            test("summarizeTodos: lista vacía", () => {
              const s = summarizeTodos([]);
              assert.equal(s.total, 0);
              assert.equal(s.done, 0);
              assert.deepEqual(s.pending, []);
            });
        - action: generate
          dest: domain_gen/summarize.ts
          skip_if_exists: true
          brief: |
            Generá un módulo TypeScript para Node (ESM, corre con `node --experimental-strip-types`).
            Exportá EXACTAMENTE estos símbolos (mismos nombres y firmas):
              export interface Todo { id: number; title: string; done: boolean; }
              export function summarizeTodos(todos: Todo[]): { total: number; done: number; pending: string[] }
            Contrato de summarizeTodos:
              - total  = cantidad total de todos.
              - done   = cantidad de todos con done === true.
              - pending = los `title` de los todos con done === false, EN EL ORDEN de entrada.
            Importante: NO uses imports externos; sin dependencias; código tipado que pase en strict.
            Salida: SOLO el código TypeScript del módulo. Nada de explicaciones ni fences markdown.
          via: ["python", "codegen/gen_llm.py"]
      checks:
        - name: domain_logic_contract
          kind: product_env
          workdir: domain_gen
          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["node", "--experimental-strip-types", "--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning", "--test", "summarize.test.ts"]
    - id: s4
      name: "evaluación con compuertas: scorer TypeScript sobre gold set — eval_gate con dientes (DES-7, MAT-4)"
      activation: always
      depends_on: [s3]
      # eval_gate: el sustrato ORQUESTA y GATEA; el scorer TS MIDE (la toolchain TypeScript prueba la
      # agnosticidad de toolchain del mecanismo, ts ⊥ python, MATURITY-PLAN §6, ADR-012).
      # bootstrap: npm install (instala devDeps del producto: typescript) + node produce_output.ts
      #   (corre summarizeTodos sobre el gold set y escribe eval/output.json). La cadena sh -c es la
      #   misma que usa ASF s8 (setup_env + produce_output), adaptada al toolchain TS.
      # scorer: [node, --experimental-strip-types, eval/scorer.ts] corre en la toolchain DEL PRODUCTO
      #   (workdir = build/product, el mismo npm que s0 instaló). Lee METAFACTORY_EVAL_OUTPUT.
      # output: eval/output.json (producido por produce_output.ts en el bootstrap).
      # degraded: eval/degraded.json (outputs deliberadamente incorrectos; pasa_rate=0, field_accuracy=0).
      # thresholds: pass_rate ≥ 0.9 (4/4 casos correctos) y field_accuracy ≥ 0.9 (≥ 10.8/12 campos).
      # Diente de dos lados: positivo = output.json pasa ambos umbrales; negativo = degraded.json los viola.
      proof_checks:
        - { name: eval_quality_gate, cmd: "eval_gate: scorer TS pass_rate+field_accuracy sobre gold set (degraded flipea el gate)", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: node, status: built }
      builds: []
      checks:
        - name: eval_quality_gate
          kind: eval_gate
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap:
            - "sh"
            - "-c"
            - "npm install --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && node --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning eval/produce_output.ts"
          scorer: ["node", "--experimental-strip-types", "--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning", "eval/scorer.ts"]
          output: "eval/output.json"
          degraded: "eval/degraded.json"
          thresholds: {pass_rate: 0.9, field_accuracy: 0.9}
    - id: s5
      name: "Corrida LIVE vs provider REAL: resumen NL de todos gateado por propiedades+eval (MAT-5) — DES-7"
      activation: always
      depends_on: [s4]
      # MAT-5: el sustrato `live_run` corre el driver de la fábrica (live/run_live.ts: fetch global de Node al
      # endpoint OpenAI-compatible de DeepSeek; resume cada lista de todos del gold) SOLO si el pin
      # (live/live_output.json) no existe Y hay keys (provider_env). El pin committeado se re-verifica con la
      # toolchain TS (node --experimental-strip-types: prop_summary + scorer) SIN re-llamar al provider — ci
      # --rederive verde sin keys ni red (§7). Diente de dos lados: el degraded (off-topic, sin el conteo)
      # flipea la propiedad Y el scorer. Co-valida live_run en TS (ts ⟂ python ASF, anti-overfit §6, ADR-014).
      proof_checks:
        - { name: webapp_live, cmd: "live_run: resumen vs DeepSeek → prop_summary (afirma total) + scorer (critical_recall+key_term_coverage ≥ umbrales); degraded flipea; pin §7 sin re-llamar", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: node, status: built }
      builds: []
      checks:
        - name: webapp_live
          kind: live_run
          workdir: .
          provider_env: METAFACTORY_LLM_API_KEY
          run: ["node", "--experimental-strip-types", "--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning", "live/run_live.ts"]
          output: "live/live_output.json"
          degraded: "live/degraded.json"
          properties:
            - ["node", "--experimental-strip-types", "--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning", "live/prop_summary.ts"]
          scorer: ["node", "--experimental-strip-types", "--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning", "live/scorer.ts"]
          thresholds: {critical_recall: 0.7, key_term_coverage: 0.6}

  provision_modes: [scaffold]
  proof_check_types: [product_env, infra_up, eval_gate]

# ── L3 · MAQUINARIA: harness (emitido del spec, D2) + infra (emitida del spec, E1). La COLUMNA (Cerrojos
# 1/2/3 + settings) NO va acá: es L4 substrate, heredada verbatim (D1).
machinery:
  harness:
    tech: "Claude Code: agents (delegación) + commands (operador) + skills, emitidos del spec"
    primitive: DES-1
    status: built
    agents:
      - name: writer
        description: "Writes bounded DIFFs for the full-stack factory (implementation, not decisions)."
        model: sonnet
        tools: [Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob]
        shadows:
          - { prohibits: "does not write or edit verdicts in .proof/", shadow: ".claude/hooks/proof_protect.py" }
          - { prohibits: "does not declare green: passed is computed ONLY by the verifier from exit codes", shadow: "seed/verifier.py" }
          - { prohibits: "does not commit a corrupt/unproven verdict (the active station recomposes green)", shadow: ".claude/hooks/commit_guard.py" }
          - { prohibits: "does not close the turn with the active station tampered or red", shadow: ".claude/hooks/stop_proof.py" }
        body: |
          # writer — the implementation slot of the {{slug}} factory
          You receive a DIFF to produce (not a decision). You work against the line and let the gate be the
          authority: you never claim green, you prove it.
          ## What you do NOT do (deterministic shadow, not prose)
          - You don't touch `.proof/` (shadow: proof_protect). You don't declare "passes" (shadow: verifier.py).
          - You don't commit unproven work or close with the active station broken (shadows: commit_guard, stop_proof).
      - name: reviewer
        description: "Reviews DIFFs that touch the trust chain; never approves without re-derivation."
        model: opus
        tools: [Read, Bash, Grep, Glob]
        shadows:
          - { prohibits: "does not approve unless the external CI re-derives the line (two verifiers)", shadow: "seed/external_ci.yml" }
          - { prohibits: "does not declare green: the verifier is the sole authority over proof_sha", shadow: "seed/verifier.py" }
        body: |
          # reviewer — trust-chain review for {{slug}}
          You receive a DIFF that touches verifier/hooks/seed/gates. You review with your own eyes; you never
          emit a verdict — you report re-derived evidence and defer the judgment to the orchestrator.
      - name: triage
        description: "Triage of a red log: root cause in ≤5 lines. Read-only."
        model: haiku
        tools: [Read, Bash, Grep, Glob]
        shadows:
          - { prohibits: "does not write or edit proof artifacts in .proof/", shadow: ".claude/hooks/proof_protect.py" }
        body: |
          # triage — fast diagnosis of a red log in {{slug}}
          You receive a red gate log. Your only product is a root cause in ≤5 lines. You don't fix, you
          don't approve, you don't write.
    commands:
      - name: gen-check
        description: "Runs the product codegen selftest (parses the blueprint, lists the files; writes nothing)."
        run: ["python", "codegen/scaffold_product.py", "--selftest"]
        body: |
          # /gen-check — verify the {{slug}} factory's codegen
          Run the scaffolder selftest: it parses the blueprint (domain.product) and lists the product
          files it would emit. Exit 0 = the generator is invocable and the blueprint is complete.
    skills:
      - name: verificar-fabrica
        description: "How to re-verify the factory by blocking (not by prose)."
        body: |
          # verify — re-verify {{slug}} by blocking
          Run `meta product-run --factory {{slug}}` and read the verdict bus (≤ max_lines), never the
          test dump. The two verifiers: `meta ci --rederive --factory {{slug}}`.
  # ── L3 · INFRA: la DB relacional declarada, EMITIDA desde el spec (E1). `services` = la topología (DATO);
  # `emit` = el glue que emit_infra escribe (dbserver/dbclient + package.json type:module); el ciclo de vida
  # (up/proof/down) vive en el check infra_up de s2. El plan ELIGIÓ node:sqlite sobre socket-Unix (sin
  # servidor externo: re-derivable). Un Postgres en docker-compose sería la MISMA máquina con otra DATA.
  infra:
    tech: "node:sqlite detrás de un socket-Unix (stdlib, sin puertos)"
    primitive: DES-9
    status: built
    services:
      - { name: db-svc, kind: socket-service, endpoint: "db.sock", marker: DB_UP }
    emit:
      - dest: build/infra/package.json
        content: |
          { "type": "module", "private": true }
      - dest: build/infra/dbserver.ts
        content: |
          import { createServer } from "node:net";
          import { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite";
          import { rmSync } from "node:fs";
          const sock = process.argv[2];
          rmSync(sock, { force: true });   // un socket-Unix viejo -> EADDRINUSE; lo limpiamos (re-derivable)
          const db = new DatabaseSync(":memory:");
          db.exec("CREATE TABLE todo (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, done INTEGER NOT NULL)");
          const server = createServer((c) => {
            let buf = "";
            c.on("data", (d) => { buf += d; });
            c.on("end", () => {
              const req = JSON.parse(buf || "{}");
              if (req.op === "create") {
                db.prepare("INSERT INTO todo (title, done) VALUES (?, ?)").run(req.title, req.done ? 1 : 0);
                const n = (db.prepare("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM todo").get() as { n: number }).n;
                c.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, count: n }));
              } else if (req.op === "list") {
                c.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, rows: db.prepare("SELECT id, title, done FROM todo").all() }));
              } else {
                c.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: false }));
              }
            });
          });
          server.listen(sock, () => process.stdout.write("DB_UP\n"));
      # MAT-3: el cliente DEJA de ser un glue standalone y pasa a ser el test de integración del PRODUCTO
      # (build/product/test/db_integration.test.ts, tipado al contrato) — el proof de s2. La infra sólo emite
      # el SERVER; el que la usa es el producto en su propio toolchain (M8 del producto).

# ── L4 · sustrato (heredado verbatim, no negociable) ──
factory_substrate:
  anti_rubber_stamp_column: true
  verdict_bus: { max_lines: 10 }
  generated_domain_boundary: true
  memory_schema: adr021
  rtm: { required: true }
  two_verifier_ci: { rederive: true, pinned_verdict: true }
  placement_law: true
  context_budget: { claude_md_max_lines: 120 }

# ── L5 · requisitos (espina SDD; id estable + satisfied_by a una estación activa + capability + verified_by) ──
requirements:
  functional:
    - id: REQ-F-001
      statement: "frontend y backend comparten un contrato tipado y el producto compila con tsc --strict; un drift del contrato bloquea (DES-6)"
      satisfied_by: [s0]
      verified_by: [typed_contract]
      capability: contrato_tipado
    - id: REQ-F-002
      statement: "la lógica del backend se prueba en el toolchain DEL producto (node:test), aislado del de la fábrica; un test roto bloquea (DES-8)"
      satisfied_by: [s1]
      verified_by: [backend_unit]
      capability: backend_logica
    - id: REQ-F-003
      statement: "la DB relacional declarada LEVANTA (node:sqlite sobre socket-Unix) y el PRODUCTO la usa: un test de integración del producto (su toolchain, bootstrapeado) hace un round-trip create+list vivo tipado al contrato; si no levanta o el producto no la usa, bloquea (DES-4/DES-9, E1, M8 del producto — MAT-3)"
      satisfied_by: [s2]
      verified_by: [db_round_trip]
      capability: db_relacional_viva
    - id: REQ-F-004
      statement: "la lógica de dominio se GENERA por un LLM vivo (claude -p, slot generate) y un contract test la ejercita; un stub o una generación incorrecta bloquea; el artefacto aceptado se pinea y re-derive lo verifica sin LLM (MAT-2, §7)"
      satisfied_by: [s3]
      verified_by: [domain_logic_contract]
      capability: logica_dominio_generada
    - id: REQ-F-005
      statement: "la calidad del output de summarizeTodos se evalúa con un scorer TypeScript REAL (node --experimental-strip-types) sobre un gold set declarado: pass_rate ≥ 0.9 y field_accuracy ≥ 0.9; un scorer que no lee su input o un output bajo umbral bloquean; el diente negativo (degraded.json) DEBE flipear el gate — prueba de toolchain-agnosticidad (ts ⊥ python, DES-7, MAT-4)"
      satisfied_by: [s4]
      verified_by: [eval_quality_gate]
      capability: evaluabilidad
    - id: REQ-F-006
      statement: "una feature del producto (resumen NL de todos) corre contra un provider REAL y se gatea por PROPIEDADES (el resumen afirma el conteo total) + umbrales de cobertura (critical_recall≥0.7, key_term_coverage≥0.6), NO por bytes; el output aceptado se PINEA y re-derive lo verifica sin re-llamar al provider; sin provider/pin → declared-deferred visible; el degraded (off-topic) flipea el gate — co-validación TS de live_run (ts ⟂ python, MAT-5, §7/ADR-014)"
      satisfied_by: [s5]
      verified_by: [webapp_live]
      capability: corrida_viva

accept_vectors.spec_yaml:
# full-stack-kotlin.factory.spec.yml — Full-Stack Kotlin/TS/PG Factory (BLUEPRINT, status: planned).
# Una fábrica de grado-producción para apps web world-class bajo CRITERIOS DUROS DE INGENIERÍA.
# Autoridad del diseño + handoff de build: docs/work/FULLSTACK-KOTLIN-INCREMENT.md (leelo PRIMERO).
#
# Pila (PLAN, ADR-012 — NUNCA hardcodear en src/metafactory/): Kotlin (JVM) backend · TypeScript/React
# frontend · PostgreSQL + jOOQ (SQL chequeado en compilación) + Flyway (migraciones versionadas).
# Contrato OpenAPI como FUENTE ÚNICA → stubs Kotlin + client TS generados (drift imposible).
#
# Este spec PASA `validate` + `design-review` (exit 0): es un blueprint de diseño COMPLETO (13 primitivas
# requeridas, cada una con una tech; cada requisito con un verifier real). NADA está `built` todavía: el
# motor lo construye por incrementos, estación por estación, probado por bloqueo (SAFE-7). El próximo
# orquestador rellena los `builds`/`checks` ejecutables y sube `status` a `built` SÓLO con `proof` real.

# ── L0 · identidad ──
factory:
  name: "Full-Stack Kotlin/TS/PG Factory"
  slug: full-stack-kotlin
  maturity: skeleton

# ── L1 · dominio ──
domain:
  produces: >-
    una app web full-stack de grado-producción: contrato OpenAPI tipado como fuente única, backend Kotlin,
    frontend TypeScript/React, base de datos PostgreSQL con esquema versionado (Flyway) y queries chequeados
    en compilación (jOOQ), verificada ENTERA en su propio toolchain bajo criterios duros de ingeniería
    (dureza estática, frescura de API, seguridad de la cadena de suministro, calidad de experiencia,
    observabilidad), 100%-generada desde este spec.
  target_framework: { name: kotlin, provider_agnostic: true }

  # Las primitivas DES que ESTE dominio requiere (paso 2 del skill). design-review exige una tech por cada
  # una (abajo, en capabilities) y un verifier por cada requisito (L5). DES-10..13 las destapó este dominio.
  required_primitives: [DES-1, DES-2, DES-3, DES-4, DES-5, DES-6, DES-7, DES-8, DES-9, DES-10, DES-11, DES-12, DES-13]

  # Blueprint del PRODUCTO de ejemplo — lo lee el codegen (factories/full-stack-kotlin/codegen/, ADR-012).
  # Representativo: una app de gestión (User/Project/Task) con relaciones. El codegen real es del build.
  product:
    package_name: webapp
    api_title: "Project Tracker API"
    # RBAC (R2/FSK-S13, DES-3): autorización por rol sobre las escrituras. `roles` = el universo de roles del
    # producto; `write_roles` por entidad = quién puede POST-ear esa entidad. El codegen emite un enum Role
    # type-safe + RoleGuard (cruza el rol del token contra el set requerido), el contrato marca x-required-roles
    # y route_check.py (modo rbac) lo verifica. `viewer` es read-only (no escribe ninguna entidad).
    roles: [admin, editor, viewer]
    # ownership / autorización a nivel de FILA (R2/FSK-S14, DES-3): un actor no-privilegiado sólo modifica las
    # filas que le PERTENECEN; `owner_bypass_roles` = los roles que IGNORAN ownership (admin administra todo). El
    # codegen emite OwnershipGuard.canModify + OwnershipPolicy (entidad→campo dueño), el contrato marca x-owned-by
    # y route_check.py (modo ownership) lo verifica. Compone sobre RBAC (rol×entidad) + auth (autenticación).
    owner_bypass_roles: [admin]
    entities:
      - name: User
        write_roles: [admin]          # sólo admin crea usuarios
        fields:
          - { name: email, type: string, unique: true }
          - { name: name, type: string }
      - name: Project
        write_roles: [admin, editor]
        owned_by: owner_id            # el dueño de la fila es el User que owner_id referencia (ownership)
        fields:
          - { name: name, type: string }
          - { name: owner_id, type: ref, to: User }
          - { name: budget, type: number }
      - name: Task
        write_roles: [admin, editor]
        fields:
          - { name: title, type: string }
          - { name: done, type: boolean }
          - { name: project_id, type: ref, to: Project }
          # priority es un WORKFLOW (R2/FSK-S12, DES-3): la prioridad sólo cambia de a un paso (no low↔high de
          # golpe). initial + transitions → guard canTransition DETERMINISTA, type-bound al enum del contrato.
          - name: priority
            type: enum
            values: [low, medium, high]
            initial: low
            transitions: { low: [medium], medium: [low, high], high: [medium] }
          - { name: estimate, type: int }
          - { name: due, type: date }
          - { name: notes, type: string, required: false }

  # Restricciones — dónde esta pila es INSEGURA para un dominio (DATA hoy; darle dientes M0 = incremento
  # de sustrato futuro chico, ver INCREMENT §8). El producto no debe planearse para estos dominios.
  constraints:
    excluded_domains:
      - { domain: "tiempo-real-duro / safety-critical", reason: "el GC del JVM no da latencia determinista", future_factory: "Rust/Ada/C" }
      - { domain: "ML / numérico pesado / entrenamiento", reason: "ecosistema equivocado para JVM/TS", future_factory: "Python/C++/CUDA" }
      - { domain: "embebido / kernel / drivers", reason: "necesita sin-GC", future_factory: "Rust/C (parte: IoT-Go)" }
      - { domain: "mobile nativo (UI iOS/Android)", reason: "esto es web full-stack", future_factory: "Mobile-Factory" }
      - { domain: "HFT / ultra-baja-latencia", reason: "el GC es inaceptable", future_factory: "C++/Rust" }
      - { domain: "smart contracts / on-chain", reason: "VM y lenguaje distintos", future_factory: "Solidity/Move" }
      - { domain: "big-data ETL / streaming pesado", reason: "runtime distinto", future_factory: "Spark/dbt (data-pipeline)" }
    affirmative_fit: "apps web transaccionales/CRUD, dashboards, SaaS, herramientas internas, APIs de negocio"

  # Capabilities (L1): cada una con su primitiva DES + la tech que el PLAN eligió. status: planned (nada
  # construido aún). El `artifact` y el `proof` documentan el objetivo del build (la hoja del árbol C4).
  capabilities:
    - id: andamiaje_regenerable
      invariant: "el producto entero es derivable de este spec; regenerar es idempotente (100%-generado, sin código humano que proteger)"
      primitive: DES-1
      tech: "OpenAPI-codegen + Gradle/npm desde el blueprint (domain.product); scaffolder determinista en factories/full-stack-kotlin/codegen/"
      artifact: build/product/openapi.yaml
      proof: "s0: regenerar desde el spec produce un árbol idéntico (idempotente); un blueprint incompleto → s0 rojo"
      status: built
    - id: contrato_tipado_fuente_unica
      invariant: "el contrato OpenAPI es la FUENTE ÚNICA; el server Kotlin y el client TS se generan de ahí y un drift de tipos rompe la compilación de ambos lados"
      primitive: DES-6
      tech: "OpenAPI → stubs Kotlin (server) + client TS generado; kotlinc + tsc --strict sobre lo generado"
      artifact: build/product/openapi.yaml
      proof: "s0: kotlinc + tsc --strict verdes sobre el código generado del contrato; cambiar el contrato sin regenerar un lado → rojo"
      status: built
    - id: aislamiento_producto
      invariant: "el producto corre en SU propio toolchain (Gradle/npm), aislado del de la fábrica; importar la fábrica dentro del product_env falla (DES-9, SAFE-2)"
      primitive: DES-9
      tech: "workspace Gradle + workspace npm propios; env scrubbed (sin PYTHONPATH/clases de la fábrica)"
      artifact: build/product/settings.gradle.kts
      proof: "s0: el build del producto corre con su toolchain; un intento de cargar la fábrica adentro → rojo"
      status: built
    - id: datos_esquema_chequeado
      invariant: "el esquema PostgreSQL está versionado (migraciones Flyway con prefijo de versión) y los queries se chequean contra el schema EN COMPILACIÓN: un query a una columna inexistente = error de compilación (la DB grita)"
      primitive: DES-12
      tech: "Flyway (migraciones versionadas) + jOOQ (tipos derivados del schema por DDLDatabase, sin DB viva — hermético); kotlinc falla ante un query a una columna inexistente"
      artifact: build/product/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__init.sql
      proof: "s1 schema_checked: jOOQ DDLDatabase deriva los tipos de db/migration/*.sql + compileKotlin; borrar una columna usada → Unresolved reference (compile rojo); regen → verde"
      status: built
    - id: datos_durables_vivos
      invariant: "el PRODUCTO persiste/lee contra una PostgreSQL VIVA: un round-trip create+list del producto corre contra la DB levantada (no un mock); DB caída → rojo (DES-4, M8 del producto)"
      primitive: DES-4
      tech: "PostgreSQL real (contenedor pineado por digest) bajo infra_up; el cliente es un runner del PRODUCTO (Flyway migrate + jOOQ create/list) tipado al schema"
      artifact: build/product/src/main/kotlin/{{package_name}}/DbRoundTrip.kt
      proof: "s1 db_roundtrip_live: infra_up levanta PostgreSQL + bootstrapea el toolchain del producto; round-trip vivo + reversibilidad (Flyway clean); DB caída → rojo (diente de dos lados)"

  # La LÍNEA DE PRODUCTO como DATO (C2/I-2). status: planned — los `builds`/`checks` ejecutables los
  # rellena el build (plantilla: specs/full-stack.factory.spec.yml). Acá se declara el CONTRATO SDD
  # (proof_checks) que los requisitos citan en verified_by. depends_on arma el DAG; s10 es fan-in (P2/H2).
  station_sequence:
    - id: s0
      name: "scaffold + contrato OpenAPI (fuente única) + aislamiento — DES-1/6/9"
      activation: always
      status: built
      proof_checks:
        - { name: contract_single_source, cmd: "kotlinc + tsc --strict sobre el código generado del contrato; drift → rojo", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: "openapi-codegen", status: built }
        - { name: scaffold_idempotent, cmd: "regenerar desde el spec produce un árbol idéntico", runs_in: factory_env, toolchain: "metafactory", status: built }
        - { name: isolation_boundary, cmd: "el producto corre en su toolchain; cargar la fábrica adentro → rojo", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: "gradle-npm", status: built }
      builds:
        - action: generate
          dest: build/product/MANIFEST.txt
          brief: "Generá el producto Full-Stack Kotlin en build/product/ desde domain.product: openapi.yaml (contrato fuente única), build Gradle pineado con openApiGenerate (models Kotlin), handler+app que usan los models, client TS con openapi-typescript, wrapper Gradle vendorizado. compileKotlin y tsc --strict deben pasar."
          via: [python3, codegen/scaffold_product.py]
      checks:
        - name: contract_single_source
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "JAVA_HOME=$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(command -v javac)))) ./gradlew compileKotlin -q --console=plain"]
        - name: contract_client_ts
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product/frontend
          bootstrap: [npm, install, --no-audit, --no-fund, --loglevel=error]
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "./node_modules/.bin/openapi-typescript ../openapi.yaml -o gen/api.ts && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json"]
        - name: scaffold_idempotent
          kind: command
          # El generador (codegen/) vive en la FÁBRICA (chassis), no en cada instancia (R1/ADR-015): para el
          # producto default cwd==fábrica → `codegen/`; para una instancia cwd==products/<p>/ → `../../codegen`.
          # Resolución relativa (sin path absoluto, portable). METAFACTORY_ROOT default==cwd lee el blueprint correcto.
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "cg=codegen; [ -d \"$cg\" ] || cg=../../codegen; python3 \"$cg/scaffold_product.py\" --check-idempotent"]
        - name: isolation_boundary
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "python3 -c 'import metafactory' 2>/dev/null && { echo LEAK; exit 1; } || exit 0"]
    - id: s1
      name: "capa de datos: schema versionado (Flyway) + jOOQ tipado (DES-12) + PostgreSQL VIVA por infra_up (DES-4)"

      depends_on: [s0]
      # DES-12 hermético: jOOQ (DDLDatabase) deriva los tipos del schema versionado db/migration/*.sql y
      # compileKotlin gatea — un drift de columna → Unresolved reference (sin DB viva). DES-4: el round-trip
      # del PRODUCTO (Flyway migrate + jOOQ create/list) corre contra una PostgreSQL VIVA (contenedor pineado
      # por digest) que infra_up levanta; DB caída → rojo (diente de dos lados, MAT-3). El codegen (s0) ya
      # emite migración + Repository + DbRoundTrip → builds: [] (la estación sólo PRUEBA).
      proof_checks:
        - { name: schema_checked, cmd: "jooqCodegen (DDLDatabase de db/migration/*.sql) + compileKotlin; un drift de columna → Unresolved reference", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: "jooq-kotlinc", status: built }
        - { name: db_roundtrip_live, cmd: "round-trip create+list del producto (Flyway+jOOQ) contra PostgreSQL viva; DB caída → rojo", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: "gradle-postgres", status: built }
      builds: []

        - name: schema_checked

          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "JAVA_HOME=$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(command -v javac)))) ./gradlew jooqCodegen compileKotlin -q --console=plain"]
        - name: db_roundtrip_live
          kind: infra_up
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: ["sh", "-c", "JAVA_HOME=$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(command -v javac)))) exec ./gradlew classes -q --console=plain"]
          up: ["sh", "-c", "docker rm -f fsk_s1_pg >/dev/null 2>&1; exec docker run --rm --name fsk_s1_pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=metafactory -p 5434:5432 postgres@sha256:e013e867e712fec275706a6c51c966f0bb0c93cfa8f51000f85a15f9865a28cb"]

      proof_checks:

      builds: []
      checks:
        - name: static_hardness_kotlin
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "JH=$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(command -v javac)))); JAVA_HOME=$JH ./gradlew detekt compileKotlin -q --console=plain || exit 1; JAVA_HOME=$JH ./gradlew detektProbe --console=plain 2>&1 | grep -q SwallowedException || { echo FSK_HARDNESS_DECORATIVE_KOTLIN; exit 1; }; echo FSK_HARDNESS_OK_KOTLIN"]
        - name: static_hardness_ts
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product/frontend
          bootstrap: ["npm", "install", "--no-audit", "--no-fund", "--loglevel=error"]

    - id: s3
      name: "frescura de API: oráculo de superficie pineado + linter determinista (sin LLM) — DES-11"

                compilerOptions { allWarningsAsErrors = true }

        - action: write
          dest: domain_gen/src/main/kotlin/domain/Model.kt
          content: |
            package domain

            /** Una tarea de un proyecto (espejo del dominio Task del blueprint domain.product). */
            data class Task(val title: String, val done: Boolean)

            /** Estado de avance de un proyecto. sealed ⇒ el `when` que lo consume es exhaustivo (dureza, DES-10). */
            sealed interface ProjectStatus {
                data object NotStarted : ProjectStatus
                data object InProgress : ProjectStatus
                data object Completed : ProjectStatus
            }

            /** Resumen de avance derivado de las tareas de un proyecto (lo que `summarize` produce). */

                val total: Int,
                val done: Int,
                val pending: List<String>,

        - action: write
          dest: domain_gen/src/main/kotlin/domain/SummaryContract.kt
          content: |
            package domain

            import kotlin.system.exitProcess

            /** El contract test (DES-8): EJERCITA la lógica generada (summarize). Un stub o una implementación
             *  incorrecta hace exitProcess(1) → gradle `run` rojo. Es el tooth de MAT-2: domain vacío BLOQUEA. */
            private fun ensure(cond: Boolean, msg: String) {
                if (!cond) {
                    System.err.println("CONTRACT FAIL: $msg")
                    exitProcess(1)
                }
            }

            fun main() {
                val mixed = listOf(
                    Task("disenar el schema", true),
                    Task("implementar el handler", false),
                    Task("documentar la API", false),
                )
                val s = summarize(mixed)
                ensure(s.total == 3, "total esperado 3, fue ${s.total}")
                ensure(s.done == 1, "done esperado 1, fue ${s.done}")
                ensure(
                    s.pending == listOf("implementar el handler", "documentar la API"),
                    "pending order: ${s.pending}",
                )
                ensure(s.status == ProjectStatus.InProgress, "status esperado InProgress, fue ${s.status}")

                val empty = summarize(emptyList())
                ensure(empty.total == 0 && empty.done == 0 && empty.pending.isEmpty(), "empty counts: $empty")
                ensure(empty.status == ProjectStatus.NotStarted, "empty status: ${empty.status}")

                val allDone = summarize(listOf(Task("a", true), Task("b", true)))
                ensure(allDone.status == ProjectStatus.Completed, "allDone status: ${allDone.status}")
                ensure(allDone.pending.isEmpty(), "allDone pending: ${allDone.pending}")

                val noneDone = summarize(listOf(Task("x", false), Task("y", false)))
                ensure(noneDone.status == ProjectStatus.NotStarted, "noneDone status: ${noneDone.status}")
                ensure(noneDone.pending == listOf("x", "y"), "noneDone pending: ${noneDone.pending}")

                println("FSK_DOMAIN_CONTRACT_OK")
            }
        - action: generate
          dest: domain_gen/src/main/kotlin/domain/Summary.kt
          skip_if_exists: true
          brief: |
            Generá UN archivo Kotlin (package `domain`) con la lógica de resumen de avance de un proyecto.
            NO redefinas los tipos: el archivo Model.kt (mismo package `domain`) YA define, y los usás tal cual:
              data class Task(val title: String, val done: Boolean)
              sealed interface ProjectStatus { data object NotStarted; data object InProgress; data object Completed }
              data class ProjectSummary(val total: Int, val done: Int, val pending: List<String>, val status: ProjectStatus)
            Implementá EXACTAMENTE esta función pública (misma firma):
              fun summarize(tasks: List<Task>): ProjectSummary
            Contrato (cumplilo al pie):
              - total   = cantidad total de tareas.
              - done    = cantidad de tareas con done == true.
              - pending = los `title` de las tareas con done == false, EN EL ORDEN de entrada.
              - status  = ProjectStatus.NotStarted  si done == 0
                          ProjectStatus.Completed   si total > 0 && done == total
                          ProjectStatus.InProgress  en cualquier otro caso
            Requisitos del código:
              - La PRIMERA línea debe ser exactamente: package domain
              - Sin imports externos ni dependencias; Kotlin idiomático que compile con `kotlinc -Werror`
                (sin warnings, sin imports ni variables sin usar, sin `when` no-exhaustivo).
              - Referenciá ProjectStatus.NotStarted / InProgress / Completed por su nombre completo.
            Salida: SOLO el código Kotlin del archivo. NADA de explicaciones ni fences markdown.
          via: ["python3", "codegen/gen_llm.py"]

          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "JAVA_HOME=$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(command -v javac)))) ./gradlew run -q --console=plain || exit 1; echo FSK_DOMAIN_OK"]

          bootstrap: ["sh", "-c", "set -e; export JAVA_HOME=$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(command -v javac)))); ./gradlew installDist -q --console=plain; docker rm -f fsk_s11_deploy >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker build -q -t fsk_s11_deploy . >/dev/null; docker run -d --name fsk_s11_deploy -p 18596:18593 fsk_s11_deploy >/dev/null"]
          # up vacío: el contenedor (levantado detached en bootstrap) ES el servicio; el proof le pega directo y el
          # teardown `down` lo baja (la fase negativa de infra_up re-corre el proof con el contenedor ya caído).
          up: []
          proof: ["python3", "tools/deploy_check.py", "http://127.0.0.1:18596"]
          down: ["docker", "rm", "-f", "fsk_s11_deploy"]
          timeout: 60
        # deploy del AppServer REAL en un contenedor con PG en una red docker (cierra la última media-verdad del
        # deploy: deploy_smoke ship-ea el ObsServer PG-free; ESTE despliega el AppServer CRUD que HABLA con su PG).
        # COMPONE infra_up (E1/MAT-3) + docker como DATA (mismo idiom que la PG viva de s9, ADR-012): build la
        # imagen (REUSA fsk_s11_deploy, ya construida por deploy_smoke) + una red + la PG (sólo en la red, sin -p) +
        # el AppServer en un contenedor de la MISMA imagen con el entrypoint OVERRIDE-eado a `java -cp /app/lib/*`
        # (la imagen ya trae todas las libs; bin/<pkg>=ObsServerKt sigue intacto para deploy_smoke). El host de la
        # PG = el NOMBRE de su contenedor en la red (fsk_s11_pg), -p al host SÓLO para el AppServer (que el proof lo
        # alcance). El AppServer connecta a PG AL BOOT (connect+Flyway+seed) → si no la alcanza CRASHEA. Diente
        # NATIVO de dos lados: con el contenedor caído (teardown rm -f + network rm) el MISMO proof no conecta →
        # rojo. Diente vivo: saboteá el cableado de la red → no connecta al boot → /health no responde → SÓLO este
        # check rojo (s9/s10/deploy_smoke verdes). El push a un registry queda declared-deferred (ADR-012).
        - name: deploy_appserver_live
          kind: infra_up
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: ["sh", "-c", "set -e; export JAVA_HOME=$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(command -v javac)))); ./gradlew installDist -q --console=plain; docker rm -f fsk_s11_app fsk_s11_pg >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker network rm fsk_s11_net >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker network create fsk_s11_net >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker build -q -t fsk_s11_deploy . >/dev/null; docker run -d --name fsk_s11_pg --network fsk_s11_net -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=metafactory postgres@sha256:e013e867e712fec275706a6c51c966f0bb0c93cfa8f51000f85a15f9865a28cb >/dev/null; i=0; until docker exec fsk_s11_pg pg_isready -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ $i -ge 60 ]; do i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done; docker run -d --name fsk_s11_app --network fsk_s11_net -p 18598:18598 -e FSK_AC_PORT=18598 -e FSK_PG_URL=jdbc:postgresql://fsk_s11_pg:5432/postgres --entrypoint java fsk_s11_deploy -cp '/app/lib/*' {{package_name}}.endpoints.AppServerKt >/dev/null"]
          up: []
          proof: ["python3", "tools/deploy_appserver_check.py", "http://127.0.0.1:18598"]
          down: ["sh", "-c", "docker rm -f fsk_s11_app fsk_s11_pg >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker network rm fsk_s11_net >/dev/null 2>&1 || true"]
          timeout: 150

# ── L3 · MAQUINARIA: declarada como DATO (ADR-012), status declared-deferred (especificada; su emit/codegen
# lo hace el build). La COLUMNA (Cerrojos 1/2/3 + settings) NO va acá: es L4 substrate, heredada verbatim. ──
machinery:
  harness:
    tech: "Claude Code: agents (writer/reviewer/triage con sombras deterministas) + commands + skills, emitidos del spec (D2)"
    primitive: DES-1
    status: built
    agents:
      - name: writer
        description: "Writes bounded DIFFs for the full-stack-kotlin factory (implementation, not decisions)."
        model: sonnet
        tools: [Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob]
        shadows:
          - { prohibits: "does not write or edit verdicts in .proof/", shadow: ".claude/hooks/proof_protect.py" }
          - { prohibits: "does not declare green: passed is computed ONLY by the verifier from exit codes", shadow: "seed/verifier.py" }
          - { prohibits: "does not commit a corrupt/unproven verdict (the active station recomposes green)", shadow: ".claude/hooks/commit_guard.py" }
          - { prohibits: "does not close the turn with the active station tampered or red", shadow: ".claude/hooks/stop_proof.py" }
        body: |
          # writer — the implementation slot of the {{slug}} factory
          You receive a DIFF to produce (not a decision). You work against the line and let the gate be the
          authority: you never claim green, you prove it.
          ## What you do NOT do (deterministic shadow, not prose)
          - You don't touch `.proof/` (shadow: proof_protect). You don't declare "passes" (shadow: verifier.py).
          - You don't commit unproven work or close with the active station broken (shadows: commit_guard, stop_proof).
      - name: reviewer
        description: "Reviews DIFFs that touch the trust chain; never approves without re-derivation."
        model: opus
        tools: [Read, Bash, Grep, Glob]
        shadows:
          - { prohibits: "does not approve unless the external CI re-derives the line (two verifiers)", shadow: "seed/external_ci.yml" }
          - { prohibits: "does not declare green: the verifier is the sole authority over proof_sha", shadow: "seed/verifier.py" }
        body: |
          # reviewer — trust-chain review for {{slug}}
          You receive a DIFF that touches verifier/hooks/seed/gates. You review with your own eyes; you never
          emit a verdict — you report re-derived evidence and defer the judgment to the orchestrator.
      - name: triage
        description: "Triage of a red log: root cause in ≤5 lines. Read-only."
        model: haiku
        tools: [Read, Bash, Grep, Glob]
        shadows:
          - { prohibits: "does not write or edit proof artifacts in .proof/", shadow: ".claude/hooks/proof_protect.py" }
        body: |
          # triage — fast diagnosis of a red log in {{slug}}
          You receive a red gate log. Your only product is a root cause in ≤5 lines. You don't fix, you
          don't approve, you don't write.
    commands:
      - name: gen-check
        description: "Runs the product codegen selftest (parses the blueprint, lists the files; writes nothing)."
        run: ["python3", "codegen/scaffold_product.py", "--selftest"]
        body: |
          # /gen-check — verify the {{slug}} factory's codegen
          Run the scaffolder selftest: it parses the blueprint (domain.product) and lists the product
          files it would emit. Exit 0 = the generator is invocable and the blueprint is complete.
    skills:
      - name: verificar-fabrica
        description: "How to re-verify the factory by blocking (not by prose)."
        body: |
          # verify — re-verify {{slug}} by blocking
          Run `meta product-run --factory {{slug}}` and read the verdict bus (≤ max_lines), never the
          test dump. The two verifiers: `meta ci --rederive --factory {{slug}}`.
      - name: correr-app
        description: "Start/stop a Full-Stack Kotlin product's app locally (CRUD AppServer + frontend + PG) with one command."
        body: |
          # correr-app — launch a product's app with ONE command
          For SEEING/using the app (not for verifying the factory — that is `verificar-fabrica`).

          - **Start**: `factories/{{slug}}/tools/dev_run.sh [PRODUCT]` (default `snipeit`). Brings up its own
            docker PG + bundles the frontend + runs `AppServerKt`, waits for `/health` and **prints the URL**
            (open it in the browser: the dashboard HOME with live counts). Port and PG are AUTO/own → it never
            clashes with or kills other `java` processes/containers.
          - **Stop**: `… tools/dev_run.sh stop [PRODUCT]`  ·  **Status**: `… tools/dev_run.sh status [PRODUCT]`.

          Notes: run from the repo root (cwd at root; the script resolves its paths). If the product was never
          generated, the script builds it itself (`./gradlew installDist` / `npm install`, slow the 1st time).
          It is a DEVELOPMENT convenience (no tooth); the proof that "the app runs" belongs to the
          `frontend_browser_render` gate (s9).
  mcp:
    tech: "server MCP de recall scopeado al PIN (Context7-tuneado): SÓLO los docs de las versiones pineadas de Kotlin/Ktor/jOOQ/React/etc., recall bajo demanda (E2); alimenta el oráculo de currency (DES-11)"
    primitive: DES-11
    status: declared-deferred
  infra:
    tech: "PostgreSQL real vía Testcontainers (docker) bajo infra_up; health por reintento, teardown SIEMPRE (E1/MAT-3)"
    primitive: DES-9
    status: declared-deferred
    services:
      - { name: postgres, kind: container, endpoint: "tcp:5432", marker: PG_UP }

La restricción es DATA-driven (opt-in por entidad), cruza contrato↔Kotlin en compile-time, y se prueba VIVO en dos lados (estado mutable → 200; estado frozen → 409) (FSK-MUTABLE-WHEN, DES-3/DES-6)"

accept_vectors.spec_yaml:
# iot.factory.spec.yml — IoT-Factory en Go (MATURITY-PLAN MAT-7 / ROADMAP F3).
# El 3er dominio radicalmente distinto: un gateway/broker/telemetría IoT en Go (Go ⟂ python ⟂ ts),
# generado 100% desde este spec por un codegen LOCAL (factories/iot/codegen/scaffold_product.py, ADR-012).
# El sustrato del Meta-Factory NO nombra ninguna tech Go. HERMÉTICO: Go stdlib, `GOPROXY=off`, sin red ni
# `go get` (el toolchain 1.26 está instalado; no hay deps externas). `go test` es el gate del producto en su
# propio toolchain (DES-8) — el análogo Go EXACTO del `tsc --strict` de full-stack y el `mypy --strict` de ASF.
# Tech = elección de PLAN (ADR-012): el skeleton IoT bosquejó C/protoc/qemu (no instalados); Go provee el
# MISMO mix de primitivas (DES-2/3/4/5/6/8/9) y es un lenguaje IoT real (gateways/brokers/telemetría).

# ── L0 · identidad ──
factory:
  name: "IoT Factory"
  slug: iot
  maturity: minimal

# ── L1 · dominio ──
domain:
  produces: "un gateway IoT en Go: contrato de mensajes tipado, topología pub/sub verificable, gate de firma OTA no-salteable, procedencia de lecturas y telemetría durable contra un broker vivo — verificado en su propio toolchain (go vet / go test)"
  target_framework: { name: go, provider_agnostic: true }

  # Blueprint del PRODUCTO — lo lee codegen/scaffold_product.py (el `via` del slot generate, ADR-013).
  # Un esquema de mensaje + una topología de tópicos + el join-key de procedencia dirigen TODO el codegen Go.
  product:
    package_name: iotgw
    module_path: "example.com/iotgw"        # path del módulo Go (build/product/go.mod)

    # Producto 100%-generado (el árbol Go en build/product, vía scaffold_product.py): NO hay split
    # humano/generado, así que esta fábrica NO declara frontera I-5 (`domain.product.boundary_*`) y la
    # gate `boundary_survives` (m04) reporta N/A honesto (H2). Antes m04 emitía un stub Python vestigial
    # (`domain/iotgw.py`) — borrado; el lenguaje vive en la spec, no en el sustrato (ADR-012).
    marker: IOTGW_OK

    # Contrato de mensaje tipado (DES-6): un Reading que el gateway valida en el BORDE. Un drift de tipos o
    # de validación rompe `go build`/`go test ./contract`.
    message:
      name: Reading
      fields:
        - { name: DeviceID,  type: string }
        - { name: Metric,    type: string }
        - { name: Value,     type: float64 }
        - { name: TS,        type: int64 }
        - { name: FWVersion, type: string }
      # Campos no-vacíos exigidos por la validación del borde (un mensaje malformado se RECHAZA, no se ingiere).
      required: [DeviceID, Metric, FWVersion]

    # Topología pub/sub (DES-2): un grafo de tópicos. El validador BFS exige que NINGÚN tópico quede huérfano
    # (todo publisher tiene subscriber y todo nodo es alcanzable desde la raíz de ingestión).
    topology:
      root: ingestor
      topics:
        - { name: "sensors/temp",     publisher: thermostat, subscriber: ingestor }
        - { name: "sensors/humidity", publisher: hygrometer, subscriber: ingestor }
        - { name: "telemetry/agg",    publisher: ingestor,   subscriber: dashboard }

    # Gate OTA (DES-3): toda ruta de actualización de firmware DEBE pasar por la verificación de firma.
    ota:
      require_signature: true

    # Procedencia (DES-5): toda métrica agregada rastrea a sus lecturas crudas por el join-key.
    provenance:
      join_key: [DeviceID, TS, FWVersion]

  # Capabilities (L1): cada una con su artifact REAL (la hoja del árbol de evidencia C4) bajo build/product.
  capabilities:
    - id: mensajes_tipados
      invariant: "el contrato de mensajes device→gateway es tipado; un mensaje malformado (campo requerido vacío) se RECHAZA en el borde, no se ingiere; un drift del esquema rompe la compilación (go build/go test)"
      primitive: DES-6            # Contratos tipados en fronteras
      tech: "structs Go tipados + Validate() en el borde; `go vet ./...` + `go test ./contract` como gate"
      artifact: build/product/contract/message.go
      proof: "s0: go vet ./... compila el módulo y go test ./contract prueba que un Reading sin campo requerido es rechazado; un drift de tipo → rojo"
      status: built
    - id: topologia_verificable
      invariant: "la topología de tópicos pub/sub es chequeable estáticamente: ningún tópico queda huérfano (todo publisher tiene subscriber) y todo nodo es alcanzable desde la raíz de ingestión (validador BFS, sin correr el broker)"
      primitive: DES-2            # Topología verificable
      tech: "grafo de tópicos declarado + validador BFS estructural en Go; `go test ./topology`"
      artifact: build/product/topology/topology.go
      proof: "s1: go test ./topology corre el validador BFS sobre el grafo declarado (alcanzable + sin huérfanos); orfanar un nodo → rojo"
      status: built
    - id: gate_ota_no_salteable
      invariant: "ninguna ruta de actualización de firmware se ejecuta sin pasar por la verificación de firma (techo no-salteable): un Apply sin firma válida es rechazado"
      primitive: DES-3            # Puntos de control no-salteables
      tech: "OTAGuard.Apply() exige VerifySignature antes de flashear; `go test ./ota`"
      artifact: build/product/ota/guard.go
      proof: "s2: go test ./ota prueba que Apply con firma inválida/ausente es rechazado y NO flashea; saltear el gate → rojo"
      status: built
    - id: procedencia_de_lecturas
      invariant: "toda métrica agregada se recorre hacia atrás hasta las lecturas crudas que la formaron, por el join-key (device_id, ts, fw_version): audit trail completo"
      primitive: DES-5            # Procedencia / trazabilidad
      tech: "audit trail con join-key en Go; round-trip backward métrica→lecturas; `go test ./provenance`"
      artifact: build/product/provenance/trail.go
      proof: "s2: go test ./provenance hace el round-trip backward (agregado → lecturas crudas por join-key); una lectura sin trail → rojo"
      status: built
    - id: telemetria_durable
      invariant: "ninguna lectura confirmada se pierde ante un corte: la telemetría se bufferea (store-and-forward) y se reenvía al reconectar contra un broker VIVO; el PRODUCTO (su toolchain) hace el round-trip contra el broker levantado, no contra un mock; broker caído → rojo (M8 del producto)"
      primitive: DES-4            # Estado durable / resumible
      tech: "store-and-forward en Go sobre un broker socket-Unix (stdlib, sin puertos); el cliente es un test del PRODUCTO (`go test ./telemetry`) contra el broker que infra_up levanta; broker caído → rojo (DES-9, E1)"
      artifact: build/product/telemetry/forward.go
      proof: "s3: infra_up levanta el broker Go (go run ./cmd/broker sobre socket-Unix) y go test ./telemetry hace el store-and-forward round-trip vivo; broker caído → rojo (diente de dos lados de E1)"
      status: built
    - id: ingestion_idempotente
      invariant: "la ingestión es idempotente: una lectura ya aceptada (mismo join-key de procedencia device_id/ts/fw_version) NO se cuenta dos veces — la entrega at-least-once no corrompe el estado durable (el dual de la telemetría store-and-forward: nada perdido Y nada duplicado)"
      primitive: DES-4            # Estado durable / resumible (exactly-once en ingestión)
      tech: "Set Go indexado por el join-key del blueprint; Accept() rechaza duplicados; `go test ./dedup`"
      artifact: build/product/dedup/dedup.go
      proof: "s4: go test ./dedup prueba que una lectura nueva se acepta y un re-envío (mismo join-key) se rechaza (idempotente); contar dos veces → rojo"
      status: built

  # La LÍNEA DE PRODUCTO como DATO (C2, I-2): cada estación lleva su realización ejecutable. m02 la
  # materializa en stations/<id>.yml. 100% derivable del spec (ADR-011). El env Go se fija inline en cada
  # cmd (`GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod`): hermético, sin red — el sustrato no nombra Go, son argv DATA.
  station_sequence:
    - id: s0
      name: "generar el producto Go + contrato de mensajes tipado (go vet + go test ./contract) — DES-6/DES-8"
      activation: always
      # s0 corre el slot generate: el scaffolder DETERMINISTA emite el módulo Go completo en build/product/
      # (go.mod, contract/, topology/, ota/, provenance/, telemetry/, cmd/broker/). dest = un MANIFEST canary
      # (lo escribe al final). El check corre `go vet ./...` (compila TODO el módulo: un drift del esquema o un
      # error de tipo rompe acá) y `go test ./contract` (un mensaje malformado es rechazado en el borde).
      proof_checks:
        - { name: typed_message_contract, cmd: "go vet ./... && go test ./contract — el esquema compila y el borde rechaza lo malformado", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: go, status: built }
      builds:
        - action: generate
          dest: build/product/MANIFEST.txt
          brief: |
            Generá el gateway IoT en Go de la fábrica {{slug}} en build/product/ desde el blueprint
            (domain.product): módulo Go con contrato de mensaje tipado (DES-6), topología pub/sub + validador
            BFS (DES-2), gate de firma OTA no-salteable (DES-3), procedencia con join-key (DES-5), telemetría
            store-and-forward + broker socket-Unix (DES-4/DES-9). go vet ./... y go test por paquete deben pasar.
          via: ["python", "codegen/scaffold_product.py"]
      checks:
        - name: typed_message_contract
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go vet ./... && GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test -count=1 ./contract"]
    - id: s1
      name: "topología pub/sub verificable: validador BFS estructural (go test ./topology) — DES-2/DES-8"
      activation: always
      depends_on: [s0]
      proof_checks:
        - { name: topology_reachable, cmd: "go test ./topology — el validador BFS acepta el grafo (alcanzable, sin huérfanos)", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: go, status: built }
      builds: []
      checks:
        - name: topology_reachable
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test -count=1 ./topology"]
    - id: s2
      name: "gate OTA no-salteable + procedencia de lecturas (go test ./ota ./provenance) — DES-3/DES-5/DES-8"
      activation: always
      depends_on: [s1]
      proof_checks:
        - { name: ota_gate_and_provenance, cmd: "go test ./ota ./provenance — el Apply OTA exige firma y la métrica rastrea a sus lecturas crudas", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: go, status: built }
      builds: []
      checks:
        - name: ota_gate_and_provenance
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test -count=1 ./ota ./provenance"]
    - id: s3
      name: "telemetría durable contra el broker VIVO: store-and-forward round-trip (infra_up → go test ./telemetry) — DES-4/DES-9"
      activation: always
      depends_on: [s2]
      # MAT-3/E1: el proof es el TEST DEL PRODUCTO (`go test ./telemetry`, su toolchain) contra el broker Go
      # que infra_up levanta (`go run ./cmd/broker` sobre socket-Unix). El socket es absoluto y compartido por
      # `up` y `proof` vía IOTGW_SOCK="$PWD/telemetry.sock" (mismo cwd=build/product). Broker caído → el test
      # del producto cae a rojo (diente de dos lados de E1, M8 del producto): prueba que USA la infra viva.
      proof_checks:
        - { name: durable_telemetry_live, cmd: "go test ./telemetry contra el broker Go vivo (socket-Unix); broker caído → rojo", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: go, status: built }
      builds: []
      checks:
        - name: durable_telemetry_live
          kind: infra_up
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: []
          up: ["sh", "-c", "export IOTGW_SOCK=\"$PWD/telemetry.sock\"; exec env GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go run ./cmd/broker"]
          proof: ["sh", "-c", "export IOTGW_SOCK=\"$PWD/telemetry.sock\"; exec env GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test -count=1 ./telemetry"]
          down: []
          timeout: 30
    - id: s4
      name: "ingestión idempotente: dedup por join-key (go test ./dedup) — DES-4/DES-8"
      activation: always
      depends_on: [s3]
      # El árbol Go completo (incl. dedup/) ya lo emite s0 (un solo `generate`); s4 sólo PRUEBA la nueva
      # capacidad en el toolchain del producto (DES-8). El dual de s3 (telemetría durable): nada perdido Y
      # nada duplicado. Sin builds (no re-genera): un check `go test ./dedup` por product_env.
      proof_checks:
        - { name: idempotent_ingestion, cmd: "go test ./dedup — una lectura nueva se acepta y un re-envío (mismo join-key) se rechaza", runs_in: product_env, toolchain: go, status: built }
      builds: []
      checks:
        - name: idempotent_ingestion
          kind: product_env
          workdir: build/product
          bootstrap: []
          cmd: ["sh", "-c", "GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test -count=1 ./dedup"]

  provision_modes: [scaffold]
  proof_check_types: [product_env, infra_up]

# ── L3 · MAQUINARIA: harness (emitido del spec, D2) + infra (declarada). La COLUMNA (Cerrojos 1/2/3 +
# settings) NO va acá: es L4 substrate, heredada verbatim (D1).
machinery:
  harness:
    tech: "Claude Code: agents (delegación) + commands (operador) + skills, emitidos del spec"
    primitive: DES-1
    status: built
    agents:
      - name: writer
        description: "Writes bounded DIFFs for the iot factory (Go implementation, not decisions)."
        model: sonnet
        tools: [Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob]
        shadows:

        \ tool\"}}\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"content\"\

        \ str) and m.startswith(\"notifications/\"):\n        return None\n    return\
        \ {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32601,\"message\":\"\
        method not found\"}}\nfor line in sys.stdin:\n    line = line.strip()\n  \
        \  if not line: continue\n    try: req = json.loads(line)\n    except Exception:\
        \ continue\n    resp = handle(req)\n    if resp is not None:\n        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(resp)\
        \ + \"\\n\"); sys.stdout.flush()\n"
    - dest: build/mcp/prove.py

        notifications/initialized\")\n        if target is not None:\n           \
        \ r = request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": target, \"arguments\": {}})\n   \

        :\"x\"}}):\n                sys.exit(4)\n        sys.exit(0)\n    finally:\n\

      \ aislado del de la f\xE1brica)"

    proof: "s02: product_env \u2014 el unittest del producto corre en su venv aislado\
      \ (DES-8)"
    status: built

    status: built

    builds:

    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/runner.py
      dest: build/runner.py

      - venv
      - --without-pip
      - .venv

      - .venv/bin/python
      - -m
      - unittest
      - discover
      - -s
      - .

    status: built

    invariant: el sandbox levanta un servicio declarado y un proof cliente lo usa
      (la infra es EJECUTABLE, no descriptiva)

      \ se conecta y lee el marcador INFRA_OK"

      \ generado, lista las tools y las llama"

        \ tool\"}}\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"content\"\

        \ str) and m.startswith(\"notifications/\"):\n        return None\n    return\
        \ {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32601,\"message\":\"\
        method not found\"}}\nfor line in sys.stdin:\n    line = line.strip()\n  \
        \  if not line: continue\n    try: req = json.loads(line)\n    except Exception:\

        \ text\",       lambda a: str(a.get(\"text\", \"\"))),\n}\ndef handle(req):\n\

        2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"tools\":tools}}\n    if m == \"tools/call\":\n\
        \        p = req.get(\"params\") or {}; name = p.get(\"name\"); args = p.get(\"\
        arguments\") or {}\n        if name not in TOOLS:\n            return {\"\
        jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32602,\"message\":\"unknown\
        \ tool\"}}\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"content\"\
        :[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":TOOLS[name][1](args)}]}}\n    if isinstance(m,\
        \ str) and m.startswith(\"notifications/\"):\n        return None\n    return\
        \ {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32601,\"message\":\"\
        method not found\"}}\nfor line in sys.stdin:\n    line = line.strip()\n  \
        \  if not line: continue\n    try: req = json.loads(line)\n    except Exception:\
        \ continue\n    resp = handle(req)\n    if resp is not None:\n        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(resp)\
        \ + \"\\n\"); sys.stdout.flush()\n"
    - dest: build/mcp/prove.py
      content: "import json, subprocess, sys\ndef main():\n    target = sys.argv[1]\
        \ if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None\n    proc = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,\
        \ \"server.py\"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,\n                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,\
        \ text=True)\n    nid = [0]\n    def request(method, params=None):\n     \
        \   nid[0] += 1\n        msg = {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":nid[0],\"method\"\
        :method}\n        if params is not None: msg[\"params\"] = params\n      \
        \  proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(msg) + \"\\n\"); proc.stdin.flush()\n     \
        \   return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())\n    def notify(method):\n \
        \       proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"method\":method})\
        \ + \"\\n\"); proc.stdin.flush()\n    try:\n        request(\"initialize\"\
        , {\"protocolVersion\":\"2024-11-05\",\"capabilities\":{}})\n        notify(\"\
        notifications/initialized\")\n        if target is not None:\n           \
        \ r = request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": target, \"arguments\": {}})\n   \
        \         sys.exit(3 if \"error\" in r else 0)\n        names = [t[\"name\"\
        ] for t in request(\"tools/list\", {})[\"result\"][\"tools\"]]\n        print(\"\
        TOOLS:\" + \",\".join(names))\n        for n in names:\n            if \"\
        error\" in request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": n, \"arguments\": {\"text\"\
        :\"x\"}}):\n                sys.exit(4)\n        sys.exit(0)\n    finally:\n\
        \        try: proc.stdin.close()\n        except Exception: pass\n       \
        \ try: proc.wait(timeout=3)\n        except Exception: proc.kill()\nmain()\n"

    tech: "Claude Code: agents (delegaci\xF3n) + commands (operador) + skills, emitidos\

    - name: writer

      tools:
      - Read
      - Edit
      - Write
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit verdicts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: passed is computed ONLY by the verifier
          from exit codes'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py
      - prohibits: does not commit a corrupt/unproven verdict (the active station
          recomposes green)
        shadow: .claude/hooks/commit_guard.py
      - prohibits: does not close the turn with the active station tampered or red
        shadow: .claude/hooks/stop_proof.py
      body: "# writer \u2014 the implementation slot of the {{slug}} factory\nYou\
        \ receive a DIFF to produce (not a decision). You let the gate be the authority:\
        \ you never claim\ngreen, you prove it. You don't touch `.proof/` or the trust\
        \ chain (deterministic shadows, not prose).\n"
    - name: reviewer
      description: Reviews DIFFs that touch the trust chain; never approves without
        re-derivation.
      model: opus
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not approve unless the external CI re-derives the line (two
          verifiers)
        shadow: seed/external_ci.yml
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: the verifier is the sole authority over
          proof_sha'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py
      body: "# reviewer \u2014 trust-chain review for {{slug}}\nYou review with your\
        \ own eyes (the trust chain is never delegated); you never emit a verdict\
        \ \u2014\nyou report re-derived evidence and defer the judgment to the orchestrator.\n"
    - name: triage
      description: "Triage of a red log: root cause in \u22645 lines. Read-only."
      model: haiku
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit proof artifacts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py

        \ is a root cause in \u22645 lines. You don't fix, you don't approve, you\
        \ don't write.\n"

      run:

        \ the LangGraph\nline is ready to generate. The e2e product is built with\

    tech: "Claude Code: agents (delegaci\xF3n) + commands (operador) + skills, emitidos\
      \ del spec"
    primitive: DES-1
    status: built
    agents:
    - name: writer
      description: Writes bounded DIFFs for the agent-systems-factory (implementation).
      model: sonnet
      tools:
      - Read
      - Edit
      - Write
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit verdicts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: passed is computed ONLY by the verifier
          from exit codes'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py
      - prohibits: does not commit a corrupt/unproven verdict (the active station
          recomposes green)
        shadow: .claude/hooks/commit_guard.py
      - prohibits: does not close the turn with the active station tampered or red
        shadow: .claude/hooks/stop_proof.py
      body: "# writer \u2014 the implementation slot of the {{slug}} factory\nYou\
        \ receive a DIFF to produce (not a decision). You let the gate be the authority:\
        \ you never claim\ngreen, you prove it. You don't touch `.proof/` or the trust\
        \ chain (deterministic shadows, not prose).\n"
    - name: reviewer
      description: Reviews DIFFs that touch the trust chain; never approves without
        re-derivation.
      model: opus
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not approve unless the external CI re-derives the line (two
          verifiers)
        shadow: seed/external_ci.yml
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: the verifier is the sole authority over
          proof_sha'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py
      body: "# reviewer \u2014 trust-chain review for {{slug}}\nYou review with your\
        \ own eyes (the trust chain is never delegated); you never emit a verdict\
        \ \u2014\nyou report re-derived evidence and defer the judgment to the orchestrator.\n"
    - name: triage
      description: "Triage of a red log: root cause in \u22645 lines. Read-only."
      model: haiku
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit proof artifacts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py
      body: "# triage \u2014 fast diagnosis of a red log in {{slug}}\nYour only product\
        \ is a root cause in \u22645 lines. You don't fix, you don't approve, you\
        \ don't write.\n"
    commands:
    - name: assemble
      description: Verifies the product generator can assemble the line from the blueprint
        (selftest, writes nothing).
      run:
      - python
      - codegen/scaffold_product.py
      - --selftest
      body: "# /assemble \u2014 verify the {{slug}} product can be assembled\nRun\
        \ the scaffolder in selftest mode: it parses the spec's blueprint and confirms\
        \ the LangGraph\nline is ready to generate. The e2e product is built with\
        \ `meta product-run`.\n"
