reject_vectors.spec_yaml:
factory:
  name: Dummy Factory
  slug: dummy
  maturity: bootstrap
domain:
  produces: "un m\xF3dulo de saludo trivial con un marcador invariante"
  target_framework:
    name: none
    provider_agnostic: true
  capabilities:
  - id: invariant_marker
    invariant: el producto porta y devuelve el marcador DUMMY_OK
    artifact: build/greeting.py
    proof: "s00: py_compile + import_runs + artifact_contains (el m\xF3dulo lleva\
      \ y devuelve DUMMY_OK)"
    status: built
  - id: release_manifest
    invariant: "una 2\xAA estaci\xF3n genera un manifiesto de release que embebe la\
      \ salida de s00 (cadena real)"
    artifact: build/manifest.txt
    proof: 's01: artifact_contains RELEASE_OK + DUMMY_OK (el manifiesto embebe el
      saludo de s00)'
    status: built
  - id: product_toolchain_proof
    invariant: "la verificaci\xF3n del producto corre en su propio toolchain (venv\
      \ aislado del de la f\xE1brica)"
    artifact: build/test_greeting.py
    proof: "s02: product_env \u2014 el unittest del producto corre en su venv aislado\
      \ (DES-8)"
    status: built
  - id: infra_sandbox
    invariant: el sandbox levanta un servicio declarado y un proof cliente lo usa
      (la infra es EJECUTABLE, no descriptiva)
    artifact: build/infra/server.py
    proof: "s03: infra_up \u2014 el servicio levanta en el sandbox y el proof cliente\
      \ se conecta y lee el marcador INFRA_OK"
    status: built
  - id: mcp_tools_exposed
    invariant: el MCP generado expone las tools declaradas (greet/echo) y el orquestador
      las invoca (el MCP es EJECUTABLE, no descriptivo)
    artifact: build/mcp/server.py
    proof: "s04: mcp_tools \u2014 el prover habla MCP (JSON-RPC/stdio) contra el server\
      \ generado, lista las tools y las llama"
    status: built
  station_sequence:
  - id: s00
    name: build greeting
    activation: always
    builds:
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/domain/greeting.py
      dest: build/greeting.py
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/runner.py
      dest: build/runner.py
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/test_greeting.py
      dest: build/test_greeting.py
    checks:
    - name: compile
      kind: py_compile
      files:
      - build/greeting.py
      - build/runner.py
    - name: runs
      kind: import_runs
      code: 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ''build''); import runner; assert runner.run()
        == ''DUMMY_OK'', ''invariante violado: el producto no devuelve el marcador
        DUMMY_OK'''
    - name: invariant
      kind: artifact_contains
      file: build/greeting.py
      marker: DUMMY_OK
  - id: s01
    name: release manifest (slot generate; embebe la salida de s00 -> cadena real)
    activation: always
    depends_on:
    - s00
    builds:
    - action: generate
      dest: build/manifest.txt
      brief: 'RELEASE_OK manifest for dummy

        '
      via:
      - python
      - -c
      - import os; b=open(os.environ['METAFACTORY_BRIEF']).read(); g=open('build/greeting.py').read();
        open(os.environ['METAFACTORY_DEST'],'w').write(b+g)
    checks:
    - name: release_tag
      kind: artifact_contains
      file: build/manifest.txt
      marker: RELEASE_OK
    - name: chain_marker
      kind: artifact_contains
      file: build/manifest.txt
      marker: DUMMY_OK
  - id: s02
    name: "proof en el toolchain DEL producto (venv aislado del de la f\xE1brica)\
      \ \u2014 C3 / DES-8"
    activation: always
    depends_on:
    - s01
    proof_checks:
    - name: product_unittest
      cmd: "unittest del producto en su venv (aislado de la f\xE1brica)"
      runs_in: product_env
      toolchain: python-venv+unittest
      status: built
    builds: []
    checks:
    - name: product_unittest
      kind: product_env
      workdir: build
      bootstrap:
      - python
      - -m
      - venv
      - --without-pip
      - .venv
      cmd:
      - .venv/bin/python
      - -m
      - unittest
      - discover
      - -s
      - .
      - -p
      - test_*.py
  - id: s03
    name: "infra/sandbox \u2014 el servicio declarado LEVANTA y un proof lo usa (E1\
      \ / DES-9)"
    activation: always
    depends_on:
    - s02
    proof_checks:
    - name: infra_proof
      cmd: el servicio del sandbox levanta y el cliente lo usa
      runs_in: product_env
      toolchain: python-stdlib-uds
      status: built
    builds:
    - action: emit_infra
    checks:
    - name: infra_proof
      kind: infra_up
      workdir: build/infra
      up:
      - python
      - server.py
      - infra.sock
      proof:
      - python
      - client.py
      - infra.sock
      down: []
      timeout: 8
  - id: s04
    name: "MCP \u2014 el server generado EXPONE las tools declaradas y el orquestador\
      \ las INVOCA (E2 / DES-6)"
    activation: always
    depends_on:
    - s03
    proof_checks:
    - name: mcp_proof
      cmd: el server MCP expone greet/echo y el prover las invoca
      runs_in: product_env
      toolchain: python-stdlib-jsonrpc-mcp
      status: built
    builds:
    - action: emit_mcp
    checks:
    - name: mcp_proof
      kind: mcp_tools
      workdir: build/mcp
      prove:
      - python
      - prove.py
      tools:
      - greet
      - echo
  provision_modes:
  - prompt
  proof_check_types:
  - py_compile
  - import_runs
  - artifact_contains
  product:
    product_module: greeting
    greet_fn: greet
    marker: DUMMY_OK
    boundary_domain_dest: domain/greeting.py
    boundary_generated_dest: generated/runner.py
    boundary_domain_content: "\"\"\"Dominio (HUMANO) de la f\xE1brica {{slug}}: el\
      \ m\xF3dulo de producto que porta el marcador invariante.\n\nEs la pieza que\
      \ el ingeniero edita. La frontera I-5 la protege: rendererizada con skip_if_exists,\n\
      SOBREVIVE un re-scaffold (un `meta station m04` no la pisa). El sustrato (columna,\
      \ gate, bus) la\nrodea de garant\xEDas; si el marcador se corrompe, la columna\
      \ lo detecta por bloqueo (no por prosa).\"\"\"\n\nMARKER = \"{{marker}}\"\n\n\
      \ndef {{greet_fn}}() -> str:\n    return MARKER\n"
    boundary_generated_content: "\"\"\"GENERADO por la f\xE1brica {{slug}} \u2014\
      \ NO editar (se regenera en cada scaffold, frontera I-5).\n\nEl chasis es due\xF1\
      o de este archivo: el runner importa el m\xF3dulo de DOMINIO ({{product_module}},\
      \ que\nvive en domain/ y SOBREVIVE un re-scaffold) y expone run(). Una edici\xF3\
      n a mano ac\xE1 se PIERDE al\nre-renderizar \u2014 ese es justamente el contrato\
      \ que boundary_survives verifica por bloqueo.\"\"\"\nfrom {{product_module}}\
      \ import {{greet_fn}}\n\n\ndef run() -> str:\n    return {{greet_fn}}()\n"
machinery:
  harness:
    tech: "Claude Code: agents (delegaci\xF3n) + commands (operador) + skills, emitidos\
      \ del spec"
    status: built
    agents:
    - name: writer
      description: Writes bounded DIFFs for the dummy factory (implementation, not
        decisions).
      model: sonnet
      tools:
      - Read
      - Edit
      - Write
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit verdicts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: passed is computed ONLY by the verifier
          from exit codes'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py
      - prohibits: does not commit a corrupt/unproven verdict (the active station
          recomposes green)
        shadow: .claude/hooks/commit_guard.py
      - prohibits: does not close the turn with the active station tampered or red
        shadow: .claude/hooks/stop_proof.py
      body: "# writer \u2014 the implementation slot of the {{slug}} factory\nYou\
        \ receive a DIFF to produce (not a decision: decisions belong to the orchestrator).\
        \ You work\nagainst the line and let the gate be the authority: you never\
        \ claim green, you prove it.\n## What you do NOT do (deterministic shadow,\
        \ not prose)\n- You don't touch `.proof/` (shadow: proof_protect). You don't\
        \ declare \"passes\" (shadow: verifier.py).\n- You don't commit unproven work\
        \ or close with the active station broken (shadows: commit_guard, stop_proof).\n\
        - You don't touch the trust chain (gate/verifier/hooks): you hand back and\
        \ the orchestrator reads it.\n"
    - name: reviewer
      description: Reviews DIFFs that touch the trust chain; never approves without
        re-derivation.
      model: opus
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not approve unless the external CI re-derives the line (two
          verifiers)
        shadow: seed/external_ci.yml
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: the verifier is the sole authority over
          proof_sha'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py
      body: "# reviewer \u2014 trust-chain review for {{slug}}\nYou receive a DIFF\
        \ that touches verifier/hooks/seed/gates. You review with your own eyes (the\n\
        trust chain is never delegated); you never emit a verdict \u2014 you report\
        \ re-derived evidence and\ndefer the judgment to the orchestrator.\n"
    - name: triage
      description: "Triage of a red log: root cause in \u22645 lines. Read-only."
      model: haiku
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit proof artifacts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py
      body: "# triage \u2014 fast diagnosis of a red log in {{slug}}\nYou receive\
        \ a red gate log. Your only product is a root cause in \u22645 lines that\
        \ the orchestrator\nreads at a glance. You don't fix, you don't approve, you\
        \ don't write.\n"
    commands:
    - name: greet
      description: Runs the product's greeting and verifies the invariant marker.
      run:
      - python
      - -c
      - import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'domain'); import greeting; assert greeting.greet()
        == 'DUMMY_OK'; print(greeting.greet())
      body: "# /greet \u2014 run the {{slug}} factory's product\nRun the product's\
        \ greeting and confirm it returns the invariant marker DUMMY_OK.\n"
    skills:
    - name: verificar-fabrica
      description: How to re-verify the factory by blocking (not by prose).
      body: "# verify \u2014 re-verify {{slug}} by blocking\nRun `meta product-run\
        \ --factory {{slug}}` and read the verdict bus (\u2264 max_lines), never the\n\
        test dump. The two verifiers: `meta ci --rederive --factory {{slug}}`.\n"
  infra:
    tech: "servicio socket-Unix stdlib en el sandbox (el plan lo eligi\xF3; sin dependencia\
      \ externa)"
    primitive: DES-9
    status: built
    services:
    - name: sandbox-svc
      kind: socket-service
      endpoint: infra.sock
      marker: INFRA_OK
    emit:
    - dest: build/infra/server.py
      content: "import os, socket, sys\npath = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else\
        \ \"infra.sock\"\ntry:\n    os.unlink(path)\nexcept OSError:\n    pass\ns\
        \ = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)\ns.bind(path); s.listen()\n\
        while True:\n    conn, _ = s.accept(); conn.sendall(b\"INFRA_OK\\n\"); conn.close()\n"
    - dest: build/infra/client.py
      content: "import socket, sys\npath = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else \"\
        infra.sock\"\ntry:\n    c = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM);\
        \ c.settimeout(1)\n    c.connect(path); data = c.recv(64); c.close()\nexcept\
        \ OSError:\n    sys.exit(1)\nsys.exit(0 if b\"INFRA_OK\" in data else 2)\n"
  mcp:
    tech: "servidor MCP stdlib (JSON-RPC 2.0 sobre stdio) + prover; el plan lo eligi\xF3"
    primitive: DES-6
    status: built
    tools:
    - name: greet
      description: devuelve el marcador invariante DUMMY_OK
    - name: echo
      description: devuelve su argumento text
    emit:
    - dest: build/mcp/server.py
      content: "import json, sys\nTOOLS = {\n    \"greet\": (\"devuelve el marcador\
        \ invariante\", lambda a: \"DUMMY_OK\"),\n    \"echo\":  (\"devuelve el argumento\
        \ text\",       lambda a: str(a.get(\"text\", \"\"))),\n}\ndef handle(req):\n\
        \    m = req.get(\"method\"); i = req.get(\"id\")\n    if m == \"initialize\"\
        :\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"protocolVersion\"\
        :\"2024-11-05\",\n                \"capabilities\":{\"tools\":{}},\"serverInfo\"\
        :{\"name\":\"dummy-mcp\",\"version\":\"0\"}}}\n    if m == \"tools/list\"\
        :\n        tools = [{\"name\":n,\"description\":d,\"inputSchema\":{\"type\"\
        :\"object\"}} for n,(d,_) in TOOLS.items()]\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"\
        2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"tools\":tools}}\n    if m == \"tools/call\":\n\
        \        p = req.get(\"params\") or {}; name = p.get(\"name\"); args = p.get(\"\
        arguments\") or {}\n        if name not in TOOLS:\n            return {\"\
        jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32602,\"message\":\"unknown\
        \ tool\"}}\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"content\"\
        :[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":TOOLS[name][1](args)}]}}\n    if isinstance(m,\
        \ str) and m.startswith(\"notifications/\"):\n        return None\n    return\
        \ {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32601,\"message\":\"\
        method not found\"}}\nfor line in sys.stdin:\n    line = line.strip()\n  \
        \  if not line: continue\n    try: req = json.loads(line)\n    except Exception:\
        \ continue\n    resp = handle(req)\n    if resp is not None:\n        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(resp)\
        \ + \"\\n\"); sys.stdout.flush()\n"
    - dest: build/mcp/prove.py
      content: "import json, subprocess, sys\ndef main():\n    target = sys.argv[1]\
        \ if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None\n    proc = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,\
        \ \"server.py\"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,\n                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,\
        \ text=True)\n    nid = [0]\n    def request(method, params=None):\n     \
        \   nid[0] += 1\n        msg = {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":nid[0],\"method\"\
        :method}\n        if params is not None: msg[\"params\"] = params\n      \
        \  proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(msg) + \"\\n\"); proc.stdin.flush()\n     \
        \   return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())\n    def notify(method):\n \
        \       proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"method\":method})\
        \ + \"\\n\"); proc.stdin.flush()\n    try:\n        request(\"initialize\"\
        , {\"protocolVersion\":\"2024-11-05\",\"capabilities\":{}})\n        notify(\"\
        notifications/initialized\")\n        if target is not None:\n           \
        \ r = request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": target, \"arguments\": {}})\n   \
        \         sys.exit(3 if \"error\" in r else 0)\n        names = [t[\"name\"\
        ] for t in request(\"tools/list\", {})[\"result\"][\"tools\"]]\n        print(\"\
        TOOLS:\" + \",\".join(names))\n        for n in names:\n            if \"\
        error\" in request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": n, \"arguments\": {\"text\"\
        :\"x\"}}):\n                sys.exit(4)\n        sys.exit(0)\n    finally:\n\
        \        try: proc.stdin.close()\n        except Exception: pass\n       \
        \ try: proc.wait(timeout=3)\n        except Exception: proc.kill()\nmain()\n"

  - id: REQ-F-002

    satisfied_by:

      - Edit

      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob

          recomposes green)
        shadow: .claude/hooks/commit_guard.py
      - prohibits: does not close the turn with the active station tampered or red
        shadow: .claude/hooks/stop_proof.py
      body: "# writer \u2014 the implementation slot of the {{slug}} factory\nYou\
        \ receive a DIFF to produce (not a decision: decisions belong to the orchestrator).\
        \ You work\nagainst the line and let the gate be the authority: you never\
        \ claim green, you prove it.\n## What you do NOT do (deterministic shadow,\
        \ not prose)\n- You don't touch `.proof/` (shadow: proof_protect). You don't\
        \ declare \"passes\" (shadow: verifier.py).\n- You don't commit unproven work\
        \ or close with the active station broken (shadows: commit_guard, stop_proof).\n\

      - Grep
      - Glob

      - prohibits: does not approve unless the external CI re-derives the line (two
          verifiers)
        shadow: seed/external_ci.yml
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: the verifier is the sole authority over
          proof_sha'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py

        \ that touches verifier/hooks/seed/gates. You review with your own eyes (the\n\
        trust chain is never delegated); you never emit a verdict \u2014 you report\
        \ re-derived evidence and\ndefer the judgment to the orchestrator.\n"
    - name: triage
      description: "Triage of a red log: root cause in \u22645 lines. Read-only."
      model: haiku
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit proof artifacts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py

        \ a red gate log. Your only product is a root cause in \u22645 lines that\
        \ the orchestrator\nreads at a glance. You don't fix, you don't approve, you\
        \ don't write.\n"

        \ --factory {{slug}}` and read the verdict bus (\u2264 max_lines), never the\n\
        test dump. The two verifiers: `meta ci --rederive --factory {{slug}}`.\n"
  infra:
    tech: "servicio socket-Unix stdlib en el sandbox (el plan lo eligi\xF3; sin dependencia\
      \ externa)"
    primitive: DES-9
    status: built
    services:
    - name: sandbox-svc
      kind: socket-service
      endpoint: infra.sock
      marker: INFRA_OK
    emit:
    - dest: build/infra/server.py
      content: "import os, socket, sys\npath = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else\
        \ \"infra.sock\"\ntry:\n    os.unlink(path)\nexcept OSError:\n    pass\ns\
        \ = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)\ns.bind(path); s.listen()\n\
        while True:\n    conn, _ = s.accept(); conn.sendall(b\"INFRA_OK\\n\"); conn.close()\n"
    - dest: build/infra/client.py
      content: "import socket, sys\npath = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else \"\
        infra.sock\"\ntry:\n    c = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM);\
        \ c.settimeout(1)\n    c.connect(path); data = c.recv(64); c.close()\nexcept\
        \ OSError:\n    sys.exit(1)\nsys.exit(0 if b\"INFRA_OK\" in data else 2)\n"
  mcp:
    tech: "servidor MCP stdlib (JSON-RPC 2.0 sobre stdio) + prover; el plan lo eligi\xF3"
    primitive: DES-6
    status: built
    tools:
    - name: greet
      description: devuelve el marcador invariante DUMMY_OK
    - name: echo
      description: devuelve su argumento text
    emit:
    - dest: build/mcp/server.py
      content: "import json, sys\nTOOLS = {\n    \"greet\": (\"devuelve el marcador\
        \ invariante\", lambda a: \"DUMMY_OK\"),\n    \"echo\":  (\"devuelve el argumento\
        \ text\",       lambda a: str(a.get(\"text\", \"\"))),\n}\ndef handle(req):\n\
        \    m = req.get(\"method\"); i = req.get(\"id\")\n    if m == \"initialize\"\
        :\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"protocolVersion\"\
        :\"2024-11-05\",\n                \"capabilities\":{\"tools\":{}},\"serverInfo\"\
        :{\"name\":\"dummy-mcp\",\"version\":\"0\"}}}\n    if m == \"tools/list\"\
        :\n        tools = [{\"name\":n,\"description\":d,\"inputSchema\":{\"type\"\
        :\"object\"}} for n,(d,_) in TOOLS.items()]\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"\
        2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"tools\":tools}}\n    if m == \"tools/call\":\n\
        \        p = req.get(\"params\") or {}; name = p.get(\"name\"); args = p.get(\"\
        arguments\") or {}\n        if name not in TOOLS:\n            return {\"\
        jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32602,\"message\":\"unknown\
        \ tool\"}}\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"content\"\
        :[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":TOOLS[name][1](args)}]}}\n    if isinstance(m,\
        \ str) and m.startswith(\"notifications/\"):\n        return None\n    return\
        \ {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32601,\"message\":\"\
        method not found\"}}\nfor line in sys.stdin:\n    line = line.strip()\n  \
        \  if not line: continue\n    try: req = json.loads(line)\n    except Exception:\
        \ continue\n    resp = handle(req)\n    if resp is not None:\n        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(resp)\
        \ + \"\\n\"); sys.stdout.flush()\n"
    - dest: build/mcp/prove.py
      content: "import json, subprocess, sys\ndef main():\n    target = sys.argv[1]\
        \ if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None\n    proc = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,\
        \ \"server.py\"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,\n                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,\
        \ text=True)\n    nid = [0]\n    def request(method, params=None):\n     \
        \   nid[0] += 1\n        msg = {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":nid[0],\"method\"\
        :method}\n        if params is not None: msg[\"params\"] = params\n      \
        \  proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(msg) + \"\\n\"); proc.stdin.flush()\n     \
        \   return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())\n    def notify(method):\n \
        \       proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"method\":method})\
        \ + \"\\n\"); proc.stdin.flush()\n    try:\n        request(\"initialize\"\
        , {\"protocolVersion\":\"2024-11-05\",\"capabilities\":{}})\n        notify(\"\
        notifications/initialized\")\n        if target is not None:\n           \
        \ r = request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": target, \"arguments\": {}})\n   \
        \         sys.exit(3 if \"error\" in r else 0)\n        names = [t[\"name\"\
        ] for t in request(\"tools/list\", {})[\"result\"][\"tools\"]]\n        print(\"\
        TOOLS:\" + \",\".join(names))\n        for n in names:\n            if \"\
        error\" in request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": n, \"arguments\": {\"text\"\
        :\"x\"}}):\n                sys.exit(4)\n        sys.exit(0)\n    finally:\n\
        \        try: proc.stdin.close()\n        except Exception: pass\n       \
        \ try: proc.wait(timeout=3)\n        except Exception: proc.kill()\nmain()\n"

  name: Dummy Factory
  slug: dummy
  maturity: bootstrap

    provider_agnostic: true
  capabilities:
  - id: invariant_marker
    invariant: el producto porta y devuelve el marcador DUMMY_OK
    artifact: build/greeting.py
    proof: "s00: py_compile + import_runs + artifact_contains (el m\xF3dulo lleva\
      \ y devuelve DUMMY_OK)"
    status: built
  - id: release_manifest
    invariant: "una 2\xAA estaci\xF3n genera un manifiesto de release que embebe la\
      \ salida de s00 (cadena real)"
    artifact: build/manifest.txt
    proof: 's01: artifact_contains RELEASE_OK + DUMMY_OK (el manifiesto embebe el
      saludo de s00)'
    status: built
  - id: product_toolchain_proof
    invariant: "la verificaci\xF3n del producto corre en su propio toolchain (venv\
      \ aislado del de la f\xE1brica)"
    artifact: build/test_greeting.py
    proof: "s02: product_env \u2014 el unittest del producto corre en su venv aislado\
      \ (DES-8)"
    status: built
  - id: infra_sandbox
    invariant: el sandbox levanta un servicio declarado y un proof cliente lo usa
      (la infra es EJECUTABLE, no descriptiva)
    artifact: build/infra/server.py
    proof: "s03: infra_up \u2014 el servicio levanta en el sandbox y el proof cliente\
      \ se conecta y lee el marcador INFRA_OK"
    status: built
  - id: mcp_tools_exposed
    invariant: el MCP generado expone las tools declaradas (greet/echo) y el orquestador
      las invoca (el MCP es EJECUTABLE, no descriptivo)
    artifact: build/mcp/server.py
    proof: "s04: mcp_tools \u2014 el prover habla MCP (JSON-RPC/stdio) contra el server\
      \ generado, lista las tools y las llama"
    status: built
  station_sequence:
  - id: s00
    name: build greeting
    activation: always
    builds:
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/domain/greeting.py
      dest: build/greeting.py
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/runner.py
      dest: build/runner.py
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/test_greeting.py
      dest: build/test_greeting.py
    checks:
    - name: compile
      kind: py_compile
      files:
      - build/greeting.py
      - build/runner.py
    - name: runs
      kind: import_runs

        == ''DUMMY_OK'', ''invariante violado: el producto no devuelve el marcador
        DUMMY_OK'''

        '

      - -c

      \ \u2014 C3 / DES-8"

    - s01

    - name: product_unittest

      toolchain: python-venv+unittest
      status: built
    builds: []
    checks:
    - name: product_unittest
      kind: product_env
      workdir: build
      bootstrap:
      - python
      - -m
      - venv
      - --without-pip
      - .venv
      cmd:
      - .venv/bin/python
      - -m
      - unittest
      - discover
      - -s
      - .
      - -p
      - test_*.py

    name: "infra/sandbox \u2014 el servicio declarado LEVANTA y un proof lo usa (E1\
      \ / DES-9)"

    - s02

    checks:
    - name: infra_proof
      kind: infra_up
      workdir: build/infra
      up:
      - python
      - server.py
      - infra.sock
      proof:
      - python
      - client.py
      - infra.sock
      down: []
      timeout: 8

    name: "MCP \u2014 el server generado EXPONE las tools declaradas y el orquestador\
      \ las INVOCA (E2 / DES-6)"
    activation: always
    depends_on:
    - s03

    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/runner.py
      dest: build/runner.py

      \ m\xF3dulo de producto que porta el marcador invariante.\n\nEs la pieza que\
      \ el ingeniero edita. La frontera I-5 la protege: rendererizada con skip_if_exists,\n\

      \ gate, bus) la\nrodea de garant\xEDas; si el marcador se corrompe, la columna\
      \ lo detecta por bloqueo (no por prosa).\"\"\"\n\nMARKER = \"{{marker}}\"\n\n\
      \ndef {{greet_fn}}() -> str:\n    return MARKER\n"
    boundary_generated_content: "\"\"\"GENERADO por la f\xE1brica {{slug}} \u2014\

      o de este archivo: el runner importa el m\xF3dulo de DOMINIO ({{product_module}},\

      n a mano ac\xE1 se PIERDE al\nre-renderizar \u2014 ese es justamente el contrato\

machinery:
  harness:
    tech: "Claude Code: agents (delegaci\xF3n) + commands (operador) + skills, emitidos\
      \ del spec"
    primitive: DES-1
    status: built
    agents:
    - name: writer
      description: Writes bounded DIFFs for the dummy factory (implementation, not
        decisions).
      model: sonnet
      tools:
      - Read
      - Edit
      - Write
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit verdicts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: passed is computed ONLY by the verifier
          from exit codes'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py
      - prohibits: does not commit a corrupt/unproven verdict (the active station
          recomposes green)
        shadow: .claude/hooks/commit_guard.py
      - prohibits: does not close the turn with the active station tampered or red
        shadow: .claude/hooks/stop_proof.py
      body: "# writer \u2014 the implementation slot of the {{slug}} factory\nYou\
        \ receive a DIFF to produce (not a decision: decisions belong to the orchestrator).\
        \ You work\nagainst the line and let the gate be the authority: you never\
        \ claim green, you prove it.\n## What you do NOT do (deterministic shadow,\
        \ not prose)\n- You don't touch `.proof/` (shadow: proof_protect). You don't\
        \ declare \"passes\" (shadow: verifier.py).\n- You don't commit unproven work\
        \ or close with the active station broken (shadows: commit_guard, stop_proof).\n\
        - You don't touch the trust chain (gate/verifier/hooks): you hand back and\
        \ the orchestrator reads it.\n"
    - name: reviewer
      description: Reviews DIFFs that touch the trust chain; never approves without

      model: opus
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob

      - prohibits: does not approve unless the external CI re-derives the line (two

        shadow: seed/external_ci.yml
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: the verifier is the sole authority over
          proof_sha'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py
      body: "# reviewer \u2014 trust-chain review for {{slug}}\nYou receive a DIFF\
        \ that touches verifier/hooks/seed/gates. You review with your own eyes (the\n\
        trust chain is never delegated); you never emit a verdict \u2014 you report\
        \ re-derived evidence and\ndefer the judgment to the orchestrator.\n"
    - name: triage
      description: "Triage of a red log: root cause in \u22645 lines. Read-only."
      model: haiku
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit proof artifacts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py
      body: "# triage \u2014 fast diagnosis of a red log in {{slug}}\nYou receive\
        \ a red gate log. Your only product is a root cause in \u22645 lines that\
        \ the orchestrator\nreads at a glance. You don't fix, you don't approve, you\
        \ don't write.\n"
    commands:
    - name: greet

      - -c

        == 'DUMMY_OK'; print(greeting.greet())
      body: "# /greet \u2014 run the {{slug}} factory's product\nRun the product's\
        \ greeting and confirm it returns the invariant marker DUMMY_OK.\n"
    skills:
    - name: verificar-fabrica
      description: How to re-verify the factory by blocking (not by prose).
      body: "# verify \u2014 re-verify {{slug}} by blocking\nRun `meta product-run\
        \ --factory {{slug}}` and read the verdict bus (\u2264 max_lines), never the\n\
        test dump. The two verifiers: `meta ci --rederive --factory {{slug}}`.\n"
  infra:
    tech: "servicio socket-Unix stdlib en el sandbox (el plan lo eligi\xF3; sin dependencia\
      \ externa)"
    primitive: DES-9
    status: built
    services:
    - name: sandbox-svc
      kind: socket-service
      endpoint: infra.sock
      marker: INFRA_OK
    emit:
    - dest: build/infra/server.py
      content: "import os, socket, sys\npath = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else\
        \ \"infra.sock\"\ntry:\n    os.unlink(path)\nexcept OSError:\n    pass\ns\
        \ = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)\ns.bind(path); s.listen()\n\
        while True:\n    conn, _ = s.accept(); conn.sendall(b\"INFRA_OK\\n\"); conn.close()\n"
    - dest: build/infra/client.py
      content: "import socket, sys\npath = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else \"\
        infra.sock\"\ntry:\n    c = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM);\
        \ c.settimeout(1)\n    c.connect(path); data = c.recv(64); c.close()\nexcept\
        \ OSError:\n    sys.exit(1)\nsys.exit(0 if b\"INFRA_OK\" in data else 2)\n"
  mcp:
    tech: "servidor MCP stdlib (JSON-RPC 2.0 sobre stdio) + prover; el plan lo eligi\xF3"
    primitive: DES-6
    status: built
    tools:
    - name: greet
      description: devuelve el marcador invariante DUMMY_OK
    - name: echo
      description: devuelve su argumento text
    emit:
    - dest: build/mcp/server.py
      content: "import json, sys\nTOOLS = {\n    \"greet\": (\"devuelve el marcador\
        \ invariante\", lambda a: \"DUMMY_OK\"),\n    \"echo\":  (\"devuelve el argumento\
        \ text\",       lambda a: str(a.get(\"text\", \"\"))),\n}\ndef handle(req):\n\
        \    m = req.get(\"method\"); i = req.get(\"id\")\n    if m == \"initialize\"\
        :\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"protocolVersion\"\
        :\"2024-11-05\",\n                \"capabilities\":{\"tools\":{}},\"serverInfo\"\
        :{\"name\":\"dummy-mcp\",\"version\":\"0\"}}}\n    if m == \"tools/list\"\
        :\n        tools = [{\"name\":n,\"description\":d,\"inputSchema\":{\"type\"\
        :\"object\"}} for n,(d,_) in TOOLS.items()]\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"\
        2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"tools\":tools}}\n    if m == \"tools/call\":\n\
        \        p = req.get(\"params\") or {}; name = p.get(\"name\"); args = p.get(\"\
        arguments\") or {}\n        if name not in TOOLS:\n            return {\"\
        jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32602,\"message\":\"unknown\
        \ tool\"}}\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"content\"\
        :[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":TOOLS[name][1](args)}]}}\n    if isinstance(m,\
        \ str) and m.startswith(\"notifications/\"):\n        return None\n    return\
        \ {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32601,\"message\":\"\
        method not found\"}}\nfor line in sys.stdin:\n    line = line.strip()\n  \
        \  if not line: continue\n    try: req = json.loads(line)\n    except Exception:\
        \ continue\n    resp = handle(req)\n    if resp is not None:\n        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(resp)\
        \ + \"\\n\"); sys.stdout.flush()\n"
    - dest: build/mcp/prove.py
      content: "import json, subprocess, sys\ndef main():\n    target = sys.argv[1]\
        \ if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None\n    proc = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,\
        \ \"server.py\"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,\n                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,\
        \ text=True)\n    nid = [0]\n    def request(method, params=None):\n     \
        \   nid[0] += 1\n        msg = {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":nid[0],\"method\"\
        :method}\n        if params is not None: msg[\"params\"] = params\n      \
        \  proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(msg) + \"\\n\"); proc.stdin.flush()\n     \
        \   return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())\n    def notify(method):\n \
        \       proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"method\":method})\
        \ + \"\\n\"); proc.stdin.flush()\n    try:\n        request(\"initialize\"\
        , {\"protocolVersion\":\"2024-11-05\",\"capabilities\":{}})\n        notify(\"\
        notifications/initialized\")\n        if target is not None:\n           \
        \ r = request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": target, \"arguments\": {}})\n   \
        \         sys.exit(3 if \"error\" in r else 0)\n        names = [t[\"name\"\
        ] for t in request(\"tools/list\", {})[\"result\"][\"tools\"]]\n        print(\"\
        TOOLS:\" + \",\".join(names))\n        for n in names:\n            if \"\
        error\" in request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": n, \"arguments\": {\"text\"\
        :\"x\"}}):\n                sys.exit(4)\n        sys.exit(0)\n    finally:\n\
        \        try: proc.stdin.close()\n        except Exception: pass\n       \
        \ try: proc.wait(timeout=3)\n        except Exception: proc.kill()\nmain()\n"

    invariant: "la verificaci\xF3n del producto corre en su propio toolchain (venv\
      \ aislado del de la f\xE1brica)"
    artifact: build/test_greeting.py
    proof: "s02: product_env \u2014 el unittest del producto corre en su venv aislado\
      \ (DES-8)"
    status: built
  - id: infra_sandbox
    invariant: el sandbox levanta un servicio declarado y un proof cliente lo usa
      (la infra es EJECUTABLE, no descriptiva)
    artifact: build/infra/server.py
    proof: "s03: infra_up \u2014 el servicio levanta en el sandbox y el proof cliente\
      \ se conecta y lee el marcador INFRA_OK"
    status: built

    invariant: el MCP generado expone las tools declaradas (greet/echo) y el orquestador

      \ generado, lista las tools y las llama"
    status: built

  - id: s00
    name: build greeting
    activation: always
    builds:
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/domain/greeting.py
      dest: build/greeting.py
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/runner.py
      dest: build/runner.py

      src: factories/dummy/generated/test_greeting.py

      files:

      - build/runner.py
    - name: runs

        '

      - -c

    checks:
    - name: product_unittest

      workdir: build
      bootstrap:
      - python
      - -m
      - venv
      - --without-pip
      - .venv
      cmd:
      - .venv/bin/python
      - -m
      - unittest

  target_framework:
    name: none
    provider_agnostic: true
  capabilities:
  - id: invariant_marker
    invariant: el producto porta y devuelve el marcador DUMMY_OK
    artifact: build/greeting.py
    proof: "s00: py_compile + import_runs + artifact_contains (el m\xF3dulo lleva\
      \ y devuelve DUMMY_OK)"
    status: built
  - id: release_manifest
    invariant: "una 2\xAA estaci\xF3n genera un manifiesto de release que embebe la\
      \ salida de s00 (cadena real)"
    artifact: build/manifest.txt
    proof: 's01: artifact_contains RELEASE_OK + DUMMY_OK (el manifiesto embebe el
      saludo de s00)'
    status: built
  - id: product_toolchain_proof
    invariant: "la verificaci\xF3n del producto corre en su propio toolchain (venv\
      \ aislado del de la f\xE1brica)"
    artifact: build/test_greeting.py
    proof: "s02: product_env \u2014 el unittest del producto corre en su venv aislado\
      \ (DES-8)"
    status: built
  - id: infra_sandbox
    invariant: el sandbox levanta un servicio declarado y un proof cliente lo usa
      (la infra es EJECUTABLE, no descriptiva)
    artifact: build/infra/server.py
    proof: "s03: infra_up \u2014 el servicio levanta en el sandbox y el proof cliente\
      \ se conecta y lee el marcador INFRA_OK"
    status: built
  - id: mcp_tools_exposed
    invariant: el MCP generado expone las tools declaradas (greet/echo) y el orquestador
      las invoca (el MCP es EJECUTABLE, no descriptivo)
    artifact: build/mcp/server.py
    proof: "s04: mcp_tools \u2014 el prover habla MCP (JSON-RPC/stdio) contra el server\
      \ generado, lista las tools y las llama"
    status: built
  station_sequence:
  - id: s00
    name: build greeting
    activation: always
    builds:
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/domain/greeting.py
      dest: build/greeting.py
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/runner.py
      dest: build/runner.py
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/test_greeting.py
      dest: build/test_greeting.py
    checks:
    - name: compile
      kind: py_compile
      files:
      - build/greeting.py
      - build/runner.py
    - name: runs
      kind: import_runs
      code: 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ''build''); import runner; assert runner.run()

        DUMMY_OK'''
    - name: invariant

      file: build/greeting.py
      marker: DUMMY_OK

    depends_on:
    - s00

        '
      via:
      - python
      - -c
      - import os; b=open(os.environ['METAFACTORY_BRIEF']).read(); g=open('build/greeting.py').read();

      file: build/manifest.txt
      marker: RELEASE_OK
    - name: chain_marker

      \ \u2014 C3 / DES-8"

    - s01
    proof_checks:
    - name: product_unittest
      cmd: "unittest del producto en su venv (aislado de la f\xE1brica)"
      runs_in: product_env
      toolchain: python-venv+unittest
      status: built
    builds: []
    checks:
    - name: product_unittest
      kind: product_env
      workdir: build
      bootstrap:
      - python
      - -m
      - venv
      - --without-pip
      - .venv
      cmd:
      - .venv/bin/python
      - -m
      - unittest
      - discover
      - -s
      - .
      - -p
      - test_*.py

    - s02

      \ m\xF3dulo de producto que porta el marcador invariante.\n\nEs la pieza que\
      \ el ingeniero edita. La frontera I-5 la protege: rendererizada con skip_if_exists,\n\
      SOBREVIVE un re-scaffold (un `meta station m04` no la pisa). El sustrato (columna,\
      \ gate, bus) la\nrodea de garant\xEDas; si el marcador se corrompe, la columna\
      \ lo detecta por bloqueo (no por prosa).\"\"\"\n\nMARKER = \"{{marker}}\"\n\n\
      \ndef {{greet_fn}}() -> str:\n    return MARKER\n"
    boundary_generated_content: "\"\"\"GENERADO por la f\xE1brica {{slug}} \u2014\

      o de este archivo: el runner importa el m\xF3dulo de DOMINIO ({{product_module}},\

      n a mano ac\xE1 se PIERDE al\nre-renderizar \u2014 ese es justamente el contrato\

factory:
  name: Dummy Factory
  slug: dummy
  maturity: bootstrap
domain:
  produces: "un m\xF3dulo de saludo trivial con un marcador invariante"
  target_framework:
    name: none
    provider_agnostic: true
  capabilities:
  - id: invariant_marker
    invariant: el producto porta y devuelve el marcador DUMMY_OK
    artifact: build/greeting.py
    proof: "s00: py_compile + import_runs + artifact_contains (el m\xF3dulo lleva\
      \ y devuelve DUMMY_OK)"
    status: built
  - id: release_manifest
    invariant: "una 2\xAA estaci\xF3n genera un manifiesto de release que embebe la\
      \ salida de s00 (cadena real)"
    artifact: build/manifest.txt
    proof: 's01: artifact_contains RELEASE_OK + DUMMY_OK (el manifiesto embebe el
      saludo de s00)'
    status: built
  - id: product_toolchain_proof
    invariant: "la verificaci\xF3n del producto corre en su propio toolchain (venv\
      \ aislado del de la f\xE1brica)"
    artifact: build/test_greeting.py
    proof: "s02: product_env \u2014 el unittest del producto corre en su venv aislado\
      \ (DES-8)"
    status: built
  - id: infra_sandbox
    invariant: el sandbox levanta un servicio declarado y un proof cliente lo usa
      (la infra es EJECUTABLE, no descriptiva)
    artifact: build/infra/server.py
    proof: "s03: infra_up \u2014 el servicio levanta en el sandbox y el proof cliente\
      \ se conecta y lee el marcador INFRA_OK"
    status: built
  - id: mcp_tools_exposed
    invariant: el MCP generado expone las tools declaradas (greet/echo) y el orquestador
      las invoca (el MCP es EJECUTABLE, no descriptivo)
    artifact: build/mcp/server.py
    proof: "s04: mcp_tools \u2014 el prover habla MCP (JSON-RPC/stdio) contra el server\
      \ generado, lista las tools y las llama"
    status: built
  station_sequence:
  - id: s00
    name: build greeting
    activation: always
    builds:
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/domain/greeting.py
      dest: build/greeting.py
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/runner.py
      dest: build/runner.py
    - action: render
      src: factories/dummy/generated/test_greeting.py
      dest: build/test_greeting.py
    checks:
    - name: compile
      kind: py_compile
      files:
      - build/greeting.py
      - build/runner.py
    - name: runs
      kind: import_runs
      code: 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ''build''); import runner; assert runner.run()
        == ''DUMMY_OK'', ''invariante violado: el producto no devuelve el marcador
        DUMMY_OK'''
    - name: invariant
      kind: artifact_contains
      file: build/greeting.py
      marker: DUMMY_OK
  - id: s01
    name: release manifest (slot generate; embebe la salida de s00 -> cadena real)
    activation: always
    depends_on:
    - s00
    builds:
    - action: generate
      dest: build/manifest.txt
      brief: 'RELEASE_OK manifest for dummy

        '
      via:
      - python
      - -c
      - import os; b=open(os.environ['METAFACTORY_BRIEF']).read(); g=open('build/greeting.py').read();
        open(os.environ['METAFACTORY_DEST'],'w').write(b+g)
    checks:
    - name: release_tag
      kind: artifact_contains
      file: build/manifest.txt
      marker: RELEASE_OK
    - name: chain_marker
      kind: artifact_contains
      file: build/manifest.txt
      marker: DUMMY_OK
  - id: s02
    name: "proof en el toolchain DEL producto (venv aislado del de la f\xE1brica)\
      \ \u2014 C3 / DES-8"
    activation: always
    depends_on:
    - s01
    proof_checks:
    - name: product_unittest
      cmd: "unittest del producto en su venv (aislado de la f\xE1brica)"
      runs_in: product_env
      toolchain: python-venv+unittest
      status: built
    builds: []
    checks:
    - name: product_unittest
      kind: product_env
      workdir: build
      bootstrap:
      - python
      - -m
      - venv
      - --without-pip
      - .venv
      cmd:
      - .venv/bin/python
      - -m
      - unittest
      - discover
      - -s
      - .
      - -p
      - test_*.py
  - id: s03
    name: "infra/sandbox \u2014 el servicio declarado LEVANTA y un proof lo usa (E1\
      \ / DES-9)"
    activation: always
    depends_on:
    - s02
    proof_checks:
    - name: infra_proof
      cmd: el servicio del sandbox levanta y el cliente lo usa
      runs_in: product_env
      toolchain: python-stdlib-uds
      status: built
    builds:
    - action: emit_infra
    checks:
    - name: infra_proof
      kind: infra_up
      workdir: build/infra
      up:
      - python
      - server.py
      - infra.sock
      proof:
      - python
      - client.py
      - infra.sock
      down: []
      timeout: 8
  - id: s04
    name: "MCP \u2014 el server generado EXPONE las tools declaradas y el orquestador\
      \ las INVOCA (E2 / DES-6)"
    activation: always
    depends_on:
    - s03
    proof_checks:
    - name: mcp_proof
      cmd: el server MCP expone greet/echo y el prover las invoca
      runs_in: product_env
      toolchain: python-stdlib-jsonrpc-mcp
      status: built
    builds:
    - action: emit_mcp
    checks:
    - name: mcp_proof
      kind: mcp_tools
      workdir: build/mcp
      prove:
      - python
      - prove.py
      tools:
      - greet
      - echo
  provision_modes:
  - prompt
  proof_check_types:
  - py_compile
  - import_runs
  - artifact_contains
  product:
    product_module: greeting
    greet_fn: greet
    marker: DUMMY_OK
    boundary_domain_dest: domain/greeting.py
    boundary_generated_dest: generated/runner.py
    boundary_domain_content: "\"\"\"Dominio (HUMANO) de la f\xE1brica {{slug}}: el\
      \ m\xF3dulo de producto que porta el marcador invariante.\n\nEs la pieza que\
      \ el ingeniero edita. La frontera I-5 la protege: rendererizada con skip_if_exists,\n\
      SOBREVIVE un re-scaffold (un `meta station m04` no la pisa). El sustrato (columna,\
      \ gate, bus) la\nrodea de garant\xEDas; si el marcador se corrompe, la columna\
      \ lo detecta por bloqueo (no por prosa).\"\"\"\n\nMARKER = \"{{marker}}\"\n\n\
      \ndef {{greet_fn}}() -> str:\n    return MARKER\n"
    boundary_generated_content: "\"\"\"GENERADO por la f\xE1brica {{slug}} \u2014\
      \ NO editar (se regenera en cada scaffold, frontera I-5).\n\nEl chasis es due\xF1\
      o de este archivo: el runner importa el m\xF3dulo de DOMINIO ({{product_module}},\
      \ que\nvive en domain/ y SOBREVIVE un re-scaffold) y expone run(). Una edici\xF3\
      n a mano ac\xE1 se PIERDE al\nre-renderizar \u2014 ese es justamente el contrato\
      \ que boundary_survives verifica por bloqueo.\"\"\"\nfrom {{product_module}}\
      \ import {{greet_fn}}\n\n\ndef run() -> str:\n    return {{greet_fn}}()\n"
machinery:
  harness:
    tech: "Claude Code: agents (delegaci\xF3n) + commands (operador) + skills, emitidos\
      \ del spec"
    primitive: DES-1
    status: built
    agents:
    - name: writer
      description: Writes bounded DIFFs for the dummy factory (implementation, not
        decisions).
      model: sonnet
      tools:
      - Read
      - Edit
      - Write
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit verdicts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: passed is computed ONLY by the verifier
          from exit codes'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py
      - prohibits: does not commit a corrupt/unproven verdict (the active station
          recomposes green)
        shadow: .claude/hooks/commit_guard.py
      - prohibits: does not close the turn with the active station tampered or red
        shadow: .claude/hooks/stop_proof.py
      body: "# writer \u2014 the implementation slot of the {{slug}} factory\nYou\
        \ receive a DIFF to produce (not a decision: decisions belong to the orchestrator).\
        \ You work\nagainst the line and let the gate be the authority: you never\
        \ claim green, you prove it.\n## What you do NOT do (deterministic shadow,\
        \ not prose)\n- You don't touch `.proof/` (shadow: proof_protect). You don't\
        \ declare \"passes\" (shadow: verifier.py).\n- You don't commit unproven work\
        \ or close with the active station broken (shadows: commit_guard, stop_proof).\n\
        - You don't touch the trust chain (gate/verifier/hooks): you hand back and\
        \ the orchestrator reads it.\n"
    - name: reviewer
      description: Reviews DIFFs that touch the trust chain; never approves without
        re-derivation.
      model: opus
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not approve unless the external CI re-derives the line (two
          verifiers)
        shadow: seed/external_ci.yml
      - prohibits: 'does not declare green: the verifier is the sole authority over
          proof_sha'
        shadow: seed/verifier.py
      body: "# reviewer \u2014 trust-chain review for {{slug}}\nYou receive a DIFF\
        \ that touches verifier/hooks/seed/gates. You review with your own eyes (the\n\
        trust chain is never delegated); you never emit a verdict \u2014 you report\
        \ re-derived evidence and\ndefer the judgment to the orchestrator.\n"
    - name: triage
      description: "Triage of a red log: root cause in \u22645 lines. Read-only."
      model: haiku
      tools:
      - Read
      - Bash
      - Grep
      - Glob
      shadows:
      - prohibits: does not write or edit proof artifacts in .proof/
        shadow: .claude/hooks/proof_protect.py
      body: "# triage \u2014 fast diagnosis of a red log in {{slug}}\nYou receive\
        \ a red gate log. Your only product is a root cause in \u22645 lines that\
        \ the orchestrator\nreads at a glance. You don't fix, you don't approve, you\
        \ don't write.\n"
    commands:
    - name: greet
      description: Runs the product's greeting and verifies the invariant marker.
      run: []
      body: "# /greet \u2014 run the {{slug}} factory's product\nRun the product's\
        \ greeting and confirm it returns the invariant marker DUMMY_OK.\n"
    skills:
    - name: verificar-fabrica
      description: How to re-verify the factory by blocking (not by prose).
      body: "# verify \u2014 re-verify {{slug}} by blocking\nRun `meta product-run\
        \ --factory {{slug}}` and read the verdict bus (\u2264 max_lines), never the\n\
        test dump. The two verifiers: `meta ci --rederive --factory {{slug}}`.\n"
  infra:
    tech: "servicio socket-Unix stdlib en el sandbox (el plan lo eligi\xF3; sin dependencia\
      \ externa)"
    primitive: DES-9
    status: built
    services:
    - name: sandbox-svc
      kind: socket-service
      endpoint: infra.sock
      marker: INFRA_OK
    emit:
    - dest: build/infra/server.py
      content: "import os, socket, sys\npath = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else\
        \ \"infra.sock\"\ntry:\n    os.unlink(path)\nexcept OSError:\n    pass\ns\
        \ = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)\ns.bind(path); s.listen()\n\
        while True:\n    conn, _ = s.accept(); conn.sendall(b\"INFRA_OK\\n\"); conn.close()\n"
    - dest: build/infra/client.py
      content: "import socket, sys\npath = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else \"\
        infra.sock\"\ntry:\n    c = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM);\
        \ c.settimeout(1)\n    c.connect(path); data = c.recv(64); c.close()\nexcept\
        \ OSError:\n    sys.exit(1)\nsys.exit(0 if b\"INFRA_OK\" in data else 2)\n"
  mcp:
    tech: "servidor MCP stdlib (JSON-RPC 2.0 sobre stdio) + prover; el plan lo eligi\xF3"
    primitive: DES-6
    status: built
    tools:
    - name: greet
      description: devuelve el marcador invariante DUMMY_OK
    - name: echo
      description: devuelve su argumento text
    emit:
    - dest: build/mcp/server.py
      content: "import json, sys\nTOOLS = {\n    \"greet\": (\"devuelve el marcador\
        \ invariante\", lambda a: \"DUMMY_OK\"),\n    \"echo\":  (\"devuelve el argumento\
        \ text\",       lambda a: str(a.get(\"text\", \"\"))),\n}\ndef handle(req):\n\
        \    m = req.get(\"method\"); i = req.get(\"id\")\n    if m == \"initialize\"\
        :\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"protocolVersion\"\
        :\"2024-11-05\",\n                \"capabilities\":{\"tools\":{}},\"serverInfo\"\
        :{\"name\":\"dummy-mcp\",\"version\":\"0\"}}}\n    if m == \"tools/list\"\
        :\n        tools = [{\"name\":n,\"description\":d,\"inputSchema\":{\"type\"\
        :\"object\"}} for n,(d,_) in TOOLS.items()]\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"\
        2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"tools\":tools}}\n    if m == \"tools/call\":\n\
        \        p = req.get(\"params\") or {}; name = p.get(\"name\"); args = p.get(\"\
        arguments\") or {}\n        if name not in TOOLS:\n            return {\"\
        jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32602,\"message\":\"unknown\
        \ tool\"}}\n        return {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"result\":{\"content\"\
        :[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":TOOLS[name][1](args)}]}}\n    if isinstance(m,\
        \ str) and m.startswith(\"notifications/\"):\n        return None\n    return\
        \ {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":i,\"error\":{\"code\":-32601,\"message\":\"\
        method not found\"}}\nfor line in sys.stdin:\n    line = line.strip()\n  \
        \  if not line: continue\n    try: req = json.loads(line)\n    except Exception:\
        \ continue\n    resp = handle(req)\n    if resp is not None:\n        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(resp)\
        \ + \"\\n\"); sys.stdout.flush()\n"
    - dest: build/mcp/prove.py
      content: "import json, subprocess, sys\ndef main():\n    target = sys.argv[1]\
        \ if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None\n    proc = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,\
        \ \"server.py\"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,\n                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,\
        \ text=True)\n    nid = [0]\n    def request(method, params=None):\n     \
        \   nid[0] += 1\n        msg = {\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":nid[0],\"method\"\
        :method}\n        if params is not None: msg[\"params\"] = params\n      \
        \  proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(msg) + \"\\n\"); proc.stdin.flush()\n     \
        \   return json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())\n    def notify(method):\n \
        \       proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"method\":method})\
        \ + \"\\n\"); proc.stdin.flush()\n    try:\n        request(\"initialize\"\
        , {\"protocolVersion\":\"2024-11-05\",\"capabilities\":{}})\n        notify(\"\
        notifications/initialized\")\n        if target is not None:\n           \
        \ r = request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": target, \"arguments\": {}})\n   \
        \         sys.exit(3 if \"error\" in r else 0)\n        names = [t[\"name\"\
        ] for t in request(\"tools/list\", {})[\"result\"][\"tools\"]]\n        print(\"\
        TOOLS:\" + \",\".join(names))\n        for n in names:\n            if \"\
        error\" in request(\"tools/call\", {\"name\": n, \"arguments\": {\"text\"\
        :\"x\"}}):\n                sys.exit(4)\n        sys.exit(0)\n    finally:\n\
        \        try: proc.stdin.close()\n        except Exception: pass\n       \
        \ try: proc.wait(timeout=3)\n        except Exception: proc.kill()\nmain()\n"
